review_text: My first time having crab and it was awesome! Got a black pepper mud crab and enjoyed the messiness, the cracking and slurping and of course it was delicious. It's a busy spot so you might have to wait for a short time for a table but totally worth it. The couple sides were salted egg prawns and Fried rice, both were fantastic, probably the best I've had. Staff were great, service was fast and the place had a humming vibe. Loved it.

author: Jason Nah
review_text: 4th Oct . Just have another great session w my friends . Bcos of a special event, managed to get help from jumbo Desmond & Mary to coordinate the event. All special thanks to them & those waitresses & waiters that serving us on that day. As for the food, tried many other dishes besides their famous chilli crab, beef, herbal prawn, fresh fish. All are delicious. Taste standard always there.. Will come again soon. 👍👍👍👍 ————————————————————————/ 30th Sept Have great dinner with my overseas guests in Jumbo riverwalk with the delicious crab, beef as well as other gd dishes.. Many thanks to Desmond as well as other waiters that served us well & very attentive & fast in attending our request.

author: Darion Mannie
review_text: Breathtaking and beautiful, this gem combines niche ambience with salivating soul-food. The meals were delicious! While the chilli-crab is the star, the supporting cast were spectacular - bringing everything together in lip-smacking goodness. Service could be slightly better in terms of explaining how to enjoy the experience, and pacing the food delivery - but I guess there is no time for niceties with the amount of table churn! Highly recommend, definitely book a table as close to the riverwalk as possible, don a bib, slip on the gloves and start slurping!

author: Todd J
review_text: Jumbo was recommended by a long time Singaporean. The service was top notch each person on the waitstaff was very attentive to your needs. We had the Chili Alaskan King Crab and the Alaskan king crab in egg whites and wine. I would highly recommend both. The only issue we had was with ordering, you need to be very specific on the weight you would like for your crab choice. We said we wanted one crab with chile and one crab with the other sauce. What we ended up with was 2.8 Kg of crab ! Wish the waitstaff made it more clear but that was on us for not asking or being specific. Overall great place to try at least once !

author: Roberto Soriano Doménech
review_text: It was a super nice experince. The chili crab is a must and it deserves the price. We tryed to eat all the dish but was too much. It was tasty, the right touch of chilli. We also order broccoli with saint jacques, wine and two mangoes, one chilli and the other with rice. Everything with a perfect service from Tammy

author: SEYEON OH (Vanessa)
review_text: Perfect! Atmosphere, mode was good. There are a lot of people and we had reservation but bit late because of the traffic but the restaurant keep the reservation for us. So nice people and delicious food. Recommend the chilli crab with rice and peeled cereal shrimp :9

author: Amy Booth
review_text: Walked in at noon on a Friday and was seated immediately. They give you 1.5 hours to dine in which was plenty of time. The food was amazing and the service was quick! The servers made sure to explain each dish I ordered so I knew exactly what I was getting. We got the shelled prawns fried with golden salted egg (not pictured), cod fish with spicy sauce, chili mud crab, and cereal prawns. Cereal prawns and salted egg prawns were similar. Cod fish was a favorite! Would recommend any of these dishes!

author: Ruby Chen
review_text: We had the set menu for two at Jumbo Seafood, and it was fantastic! The crabs were fresh and perfectly seasoned. The portion sizes were generous, and the set allowed us to try a variety of dishes, all of which were delicious. A great dining experience from start to finish!

author: YipeeKaYay
review_text: Food: 3 service: 5. Atmosphere: 4 Came here for their specialty dishes: crab in chili, black pepper crab and cereal prawns. Also ordered the scallops (came late, hands already filled with crab sauce, not photographed) and kangkong. Strong AC indoor and beautiful seating outside on the water edge

author: Iris Isabelle
review_text: Our server Antonio was very nice and served us well! The good as always was great. The 50% off promo for Alaskan King Crab is always worth it.

author: Calvin Tan
review_text: Had an incredible evening hosting a family birthday event in VIP room 4 on 11 Aug 2025. Thank you Jumbo Riverwalk for the impeccable and thoughtful service. Special thanks to Zhang Mingyu and her crew for the memorable experience provided. Kudos for the signature Jumbo delights for satisfying our tummies too!

author: David Tom
review_text: Their chilli crab was delicious. Location was great, and the service was really good. Just know there's a time limit to finish your meal, and the cost will be higher due to it's location and popularity.

author: fanny cheung
review_text: The chili grab is never disappointed! We ordered other seafood such as razor clams, prawns and steamed cod fish. The fish was a big surprise, as they put egg white at the bottom and it’s just the best we have ever had.

author: Don Banchit
review_text: We hadn't booked but stopped by to check and luckily we were able to get a table. We ordered the singapore chilli crab, Fried goby fish, salted egg prawns, and seafood rice. The food was amazing as expected, you won't be disappointed.

author: Velvina Lim
review_text: Had A happy belly. Lavi taco offer a brunch menu with unique Mexican-inspired dishes, and did it impress! - Signature Birria Tacos (Limited, $25/2 pcs) Slow cooked Brisket and Oxtail which is juicy, tender, and flavourful loaded full inside crispy taco shells. The shell is somewhat similar to Prata and crispy with every bite. The melted cheese within adds oomph to the taste. - 72Hr Sticky Beef ribs ($36) This dish is fork tender and fall-off-the-bones meat. The cornbread is simply good! - Lamb Rack ($38) 2 pieces of lamb rack which is thick, with appropriate fats that make the whole dish enjoyable. It's so meaty and taste is similar to between satay spices or the Chinese Spice powder on bbq meat . It would be great to be served with Yogurt or Sour cream as I do not fancy the Sour, green sauce on the dish. The dishes are different from other Mexican dishes that we've tried. I could say it's one of the best. There's several sharing platters, which we saw that come in a big portion. The hosts are very friendly, and the 2 chefs in kitchen even bade us farewell as we're on our way out from the open kitchen. Conveniently located at Maxwell Mrt right next to the hawker centre. High table and chairs for indoor, and there's a outdoor seating for people watch.

author: Chi Hong Hwang
review_text: Great vibe. Very chill. Good place to hang out with friends. I was here with one of my sons. He was buying me my birthday dinner. We had good conversations about life and things. The tacos were great. We had a platter which came with beef, prawns and vegetables. Very tasty. The accompanying beers and cocktails were nice. Perhaps one suggestion is to provide napkins for wiping hands. Can get messy but thankfully toilets are just a stone throw away.

author: Christopher Leong
review_text: Great vibes at this taco joint last night. The tacos were on point. The wife was especially impressed with the fish tacos and the masala lamb ones were outstanding too. We liked the small touch that they lightly fried the tacos for the saucy lamb, while they baked the tacos for the fried fish. The esquisites were also a flavour bomb. Highly recommended, though best to go down on cooler nights.

author: r qian
review_text: The food is so nice!! Love the beed tacos & the thai fish tacos 🌮 The tacos looks a bit small, but the fillings inside it’s actually A LOT!! Especially shout out to the loaded nachos, they do give a generous portion of cheese in it as well. The atmosphere there it’s totally different once you step in. Will definitely wanna try again!

author: Charm C
review_text: Place is fully outdoors, so can be a little humid and hot at times. Food is amazing, especially the beef birria tacos! Can be on the pricey side ($25 for 2 tacos) but for the quality it's definitely worth trying. No GST and service charge though which is a plus!

author: Eleanor Ang
review_text: The place is hard to find if you dont drive. However, once you reach the place, it has great atmosphere. We ordered the butter prawn tacos and crispy thai fish tacos. Was looking forward to the butter prawn tacos but i feel that it isnt buttery enough for my liking. I prefer the cripsy thai fish.

author: Soo A
review_text: Hidden gem that are known by many now and it is so difficult to book a table these days 😭 but they have amazing foods and cocktails (next door). Vibes are amazing. I enjoyed every minute here. Staffs are friendly but there are not enough staffs covering the place. Difficult to get the staffs' assistance, it's better that I sort things out. Quite warm because it's outdoor terrace, so wear light or sweat.

author: Nowo Kasturi
review_text: Oh Lavi, Lavi, Lavi~ look at this beauty. Can hehe haha make your own taco. (But i dont like doing work for my food. My friends like to tho!)

author: Nick
review_text: This place for weekday nights is surprisingly chill and what better way to end of a hard day of work then popping by here for some Tacos and drinks. Side note thought theres no air conditioning but then its an open space so at night if its windy its pretty relaxing actually. For food wise, I would think its definitely an above average. The Fish Tacos is definitely the highlight and the friedness compliments well.

author: Jovial
review_text: Hits the spot 100%. Soft flour tacos at the perfect thickness, chewy + never soggy. And oh do they go heavy on the fresh stuff: not just quantity but crunch, colour, and flavour, with a super satisfying swipe of white Baja sauce to tie it all together. Every bite is bright and lifted by a creamy, high quality guac. You’ll want a napkin, but trust me when I say you won’t mind. The birria hard taco brings the indulgence to all that veg-forward comfort with its brittle fried shell, tender slow-cooked brisket, and a rich, meaty consommé. Every bite gives you melty cheese, braising juices, and satiating warmth.... ahh. Sip cola, chase with a citrusy gulp, and you’re set for a solid, satisfying, and very vibey meal.

author: Melodie
review_text: Food was good! The atmosphere was really nice too but there were diners smoking which wasn’t very pleasant Fish taco was good

author: xyyy
review_text: Went there a few weeks ago with friends and had a lovely time. The tacos were deliciously seasoned especially the fish tacos. Staff were friendly and helpful, made us feel comfortable from when we first step foot in their vibey open air area. Came on a weekday night so it was rather quiet but we thoroughly enjoyed the more laid back and chill atmosphere. Will definitely come back!

author: fels k
review_text: Great Mexican fare in a vibrant, energetic environment! Got the meat platter for 2 to share amongst 3 people and we were stuffed! Jalapeño poppers were amazing as well. Must get the guacamole (+$3) add-on, seriously fresh and creamy. Staff were friendly and vibes were great! Will come back again :)

author: Carmen
review_text: Great tacos! The prawn ones were an absolute standout - highly recommend!! The birria/oxtail ones were also recommended to me - too spicy for me but my friends loved them. The queso chips were moreish, really great to pick at. I also got the churros - warm and chewy! I think the dipping sauce could be a bit thicker but that’s minor nitpick. Great vibes in the courtyard too.

author: Emerson Boon
review_text: Good ambience; there is no airconditioning but there are some fans. Was able to seat 2 persons without making a booking. We had the Mala Chicken and the Birria; both were rich and delicious. Will come back for a weekday dinner after work.

author: Keith Li
review_text: Got the 69 bucks sharing platter. The Argentinian prawns were really yummy! They were quite fresh and sweet too. Brisket was a little tough but the seasoning made up for it. Mala chicken was alright, also a little tough but still can. The other condiments served alongside was quite good, I like the roasted peppers!

author: Sherry
review_text: Amazing food and service. Came for the live music on Wednesdays but it’s moved to Saturday. My fault for not checking beforehand. We still had an amazing time.

author: SY Oh
review_text: A pretty cool outdoor setting with graffiti art but it was kinda noisy to hear each other. Ordered two pints of premium suntory beer (which never fails!), two yummy fish tacos and one rendang chicken nachos to share! Rendang chicken was alright, was expecting a little more! But glad we didnt over order as the portion was just nice for two.

author: David Clark
review_text: Some of the best tacos and gluten free food you’ll find in Singapore. Caught in a “shower” so stayed for beers too. Great options in the fridge and Little Creatures on tap. Lovely team and staff

author: Jonathan Wan
review_text: This is your typical quintessential Perth, Australia; pub experience. Carrying the vibes of the what the former revered Fremantle Little Creatures use to offer; this place is pumping. The menu pricing would make the former Australian prime minister Scott Morrison question whether Australians can’t afford housing because of smashed avo on toast, or eating at Lavi Taco. Write a review for free Pandan Churros

author: hels
review_text: 10/10 an authentic, humble Filipino food place that reminded me of home:) food was impeccable (and under $30!?). Ordered the chicken sisig and inasal which both came with rice. The portions were very generous and perfect for sharing. Came in the evening and most of the karinderia food was gone, unfortunately, but a good excuse to come back for more. The 10/10 Milo, gulaman was good too. Food came out extremely fast, overall very good vibes, literally wanted to go back the next day.

author: Fiyah Faith
review_text: My first time trying authentic halal filipino food with colleagues. We bought the boodlefight set 2 and everything was so yummy. Their egg had onion and eggplant which was a surprising mix. The chicken was barbecued with the sweet sauce. We also had a side of liang which was a yam paste. The staff were friendly and while the indoor space was small, we were seated more spaciously at the sheltered outdoors. The location had a mushollah/prayer room which was a nice addition. The only feedback I would give is, there is a reasonable waiting time for the food preparation so if you are in a hurry, you should eat elsewhere.

author: C T
review_text: It’s rare to find halal Filipino food in Singapore, so this place is a gem! I loved the Chicken Sisig—definitely a must-try. The Chicken Inasal and Oxtail Soup were also really good. I appreciated the localized Halo-Halo—it’s less sweet than the traditional Filipino version, which suits my taste better. The Turon (fried banana) was another favorite! The only downside is the ambience—it can get quite warm as there’s no air-conditioning.

author: pokemon phua
review_text: Food is average at best but the appalling thing is definitely the price. Nested in ubi, you would have never thought that prices here would be steep. For reference, chicken rice here cost $3.50, while a plate of sambal fried rice cost $5. However, being the only nasi padang stall here has allowed them to monopolize the market and become very complacent with the prices. I bought 1 meat, one sambal goreng and one begedil only to be charged $7.35! Totally unacceptable as this is similar to CBD pricing. Been to many neighbourhood nasi padang stalls and i dare say this is BY FAR the MOST EXPENSIVE nasi padang. Go at your very own risk but you are sure to break the bank. 💸💸💸(Maybe thats why they are right beside the ATM haha) Portion size: FRIGGIN LITTLE they expect to feed an adult with this is shocking like the rice and the sambal goreng is so pathetic Quality: CHICKEN IS NOT COOKED. Please see the attached picture. ITS STILL RAW!!! Had to air fry it again myself….

author: KhaiDougie Tomlinson
review_text: Absolutely unforgettable! From the moment we walked into the restaurant we knew we were in for a treat. The ambiance was so inviting, the staff and owner were incredibly attentive, and top notch service and the food was simply divine. Despite Fasting month, and they have to attend orders, they still prioritise the people who are fasting.👍👍 This place is a gem and good service. The female owner deserve credits! Power la.

author: emz
review_text: As a filipino... the food here is really mid... ESPECIALLY for what they're priced at... the halohalo wasn't sweet enough and the ice had already melted the moment it arrived? area is really humid unless u're fortunate enough to sit next to the fan... the condiments aren't refilled... but the staff were very nice!! just not good food...

author: nyaw kyungji
review_text: A lovely and friendly couple serving authentic Philippine halal food. Generous portions and a hearty meal — a great way to start your day!

author: Mark Justine Segovia
review_text: My Filipino food cravings were truly satisfied! The food here is excellent, and the staff are very friendly and accommodating. I thoroughly enjoyed their authentic Filipino dishes. I highly recommend Nanay’s Kitchen if you’re craving delicious Filipino food 💯💯

author: Patrick Adrian Trinidad
review_text: I've have come from Philippines to work in a foreign country, and I can say I missed the local dishes, my friends, and the culture. Longing for something from Home, I looked in Google and stumbled upon this kitchen, it's a mix of Philippine/Malay Food, I felt welcomed. I've been eating here since Last July 2024, and I have never missed a month. I make sure to visit once a month and I am delighted to eat every time the same thing, my favorite food is Sizzling Sisig, previously I only preferred to eat without Chili Peppers since I couldn't take spicy food, however as time passes by I have started to like them, I plan to try to bring my colleagues however its very far from my office its 15-20 minutes' walk. I'm very happy for making friends with the people here since I can preorder my meal since it has to be newly cooked and when I arrive its already prepared! I'm very happy and will be back for more Sizzling Sisig with 2 Rice each time! don't worry there is a cheaper option since the meals differ from each other! Sizzling Sisig is 11 SGD with 1 Rice Add 1 more Rice 1 SGD (Drink 1-2SGD) Total 12 SGD.

author: Timothy Teo
review_text: Rare Filipino Halal place. They also serve local Malay dishes like Mee Goreng and Nasi Lemak. Definite must try dessert is the Halo-halo, similar to local Ice Chang but sweeter and more ingredients like leche flan.

author: Angelica Ferrer
review_text: If you are looking for Authentic Filipino Food, Nanay’s Kitchen is definitely something that could satisfy your cravings and a go to place when youre thinking of something nice to eat at very affordable budget.

author: jayden
review_text: Superb Phillipine and Malay cuisine in the neighbourhood, very much accessible via ubi downtown line. The oxtail bulalo is delicious and has the strong bony taste of oxtail, the soup is not over flavourful or overpowering kind, it's just the right taste which will warms up your stomach especially on a cold day. It's pretty good to go with rice especially if you add some lime into it and their special homemade sambal which is good too(note that their sambal has this unique taste of which is not spicy however still has the sambal taste to it). They do also have chilli padi and lime condiments which you can add as you wish. The nasi lemak rice is fragrance and soft, the chicken is crispy however the nasi lemak chilli is not those of sambal or spicy, it's sweet thus might not be the kind of chilli which we locally love on the traditional nasi lemak. However just ask for the homemade sambal instead and you are good to go! The curry vegetable is also nice even though it's lukewarm which usually I would dislike or feel turn off, however it's still pretty awesome and this is one of the few lukewarm currys which I still will give it a thumbs up. However the place has many mosquitoes, me and my friend was being bitten a few times there, the outside seats tables are also not that clean and prone to crows which are eating the leftovers from diners which have left, might be good if the staff could clear the plates or set a rule for diners to clear the plates to avoid crows hovering over the leftover food which is quite unhygienic for the rest of the diners still eating near the tables.

author: Regiena M
review_text: This is my second time having Boodle Fight in less than a week and the food experience was superb. The star dishes are sizzling chicken sisig, grilled sotong, fried milkfish, chicken bbq and chicken skin. The food is well seasoned, delicious and appetizing! My family and friends enjoyed the food experience and has positive feedback as well. Come and try the authentic Filipino halal dishes. Next time I visit Nanay’s Kitchen I will try their nasi padang dishes.

author: Rochelle (OchieBon)
review_text: So accessible via Ubi MRT, if you are craving for Halal Filipino Malay food, this place is for u! Nanay's Kitchen means Mother's Kitchen in English and you can really expect homecooked filipino dishes that is sprinkle with mother's love no wonder why the food here is soo delicious plus with great quality & yet very affordable!!! Even the drinks, a lot to choose from even teh-c and the kopi-c plus the bandung and limau C my gosh i live this kind of drink while enjoying my Pinoy Food! Make sure to try their bbq!!! the best! from the beef hotdog, beef skewers (so soft!!!), chicken feet, and the boodle fight (eating on a long table with bare hands) was the ultimate feast! the milkfish, tilapia, pansit super wow, grilled chicken etc on top of the rice was really a show stopper!! Dont worry the food is not salty at all plus the desserts not too sweet thats why i enjoyed everything! must try mais con yelo with yema goodness in evey bite! Oh they have karaoke!! Bulalo and tocino was a hit too! Worth visiting this place i promise u! check them out at Outram too!

author: shiela lim de leon
review_text: Food that is close to home! the dishes are savory and delectable. Dessert is refreshing and sweet!

author: aisyah
review_text: Second time dining here, it's a wonderful place to dine in, they sell a wide variety so there's something for everyone. Their food is excellent, drinks and desserts are also delicious. The staff here are extremely friendly, good vibes all around. The person in charge is very welcoming and makes the experience wholesome.There's a musollah here too, definitely a plus. Will definitely be returning here again!

author: Kenna
review_text: Very nice food and ambience. Authentic filipino food! I would definitely go back here. Me and my friends really enjoy the feast!

author: SH
review_text: Delicious food served! Must try their fried banana roll! Kept dreaming about it. Their rice portions were big for us, can consider sharing if small eaters. Do take note the hotplate comes with a serving of rice as well. Felt like mum's homecooked food.

author: Jeremy Teng
review_text: Went after watching the feature on TSL. Really doesn't disappoint, very affordable and good selection. Had the lamb and it wasn't too gamy, and the eggplant egg is good! The fish that I ordered was yummyyyyy. Make sure to order halo halo as well!! Sinful and good

author: Maryann Alvarado
review_text: Halal filipino food just stone throw from ubi mrt. I got the sagot gulaman, but it's very sweet, one sip, and I feel I'll have diabetes. The sisig with rice is just okay. The chicken sisig has a lot of onion compared to the meat. Partner likes it, though, but I hope the meat will be more than onion. I'll come back, though, to try other food.

author: Philip Saulescu
review_text: The food was great, the ingredients were very good but be careful with the spice levels. We tried the second spice level and it was a bit too spicy for us, even though we consider ourselves spicy eaters. I gave this place 4 stars not because of the food, but because of the waiting time. We stayed in line around 15-20 minutes to order, and then they told us that the food will be ready in 35 mins. We actually ate 1h after we ordered because they were late. Other than that this place is worth visiting for the great food.

author: Evana Mannan
review_text: MARK DOES NOT PLAY!!!! The spice levels are no joke 😭 I love spicy and always add lots of spice, but Mark is on another level. I tried the signature level 4 and I immediately got hiccups from how spicy it was. However, the flavor was absolutely delicious! I got the beef with spice level four and my husband got the wagyu with spice level three. If you get any level more than three then I suggest to get two or more eggs to balance it out. All in all a great experience and I recommend!

author: Christopher U
review_text: Had to find time to try Phed Mark’s while in Bangkok since I’ve been watching Mark Wiens for years now and want to try his Pad Kra Pao. We had our dinner coming back from our Safari World. Luckily no lines so it took only 10 mins for our 10 orders. Simple and small menu but it’s full/packed of deliciousness. Eight veg/meat/seafood options that includes rice and fried duck egg. Enjoyed our Sour Pork (Spicy/Recommended) & Beef (Non-spicy) Phad Kra Pao. Meats were full of umami flavors and love the perfectly fried duck egg. Highly recommended!

author: onJuice Nguyen
review_text: When you get there, you need to order first then wait outside for your number to be called. They let us know that it will be around 20 mins and this was around 12:30pm which wasn’t too bad. So basically they only serve one type of dish, Pad Kra Pao. Which is just duck egg on top of rice and mince meat with chilli. I had the chicken with spicy level 3 (recommended) with 2 duck yolks. I like enjoy chilli and handle quite abit before it gets too spicy. I thought the level 3 was just beginning of the spicy level and wasn’t that hot that people are claiming it to be. But it might be the recommended option as the spice level doesn’t overpower the flavours. But if you love your spice, I recommend 4 or 5. Overall, nothing special. Didn’t even end up finishing the dish. Flavours didn’t pop. Dish felt very dry and not that enjoyable to finish. Must be the hype.

author: Thomas
review_text: Phed Mark is exactly the kind of place you want to discover in Bangkok: a small spot with big flavor. The Pad Krapao was intense, full of aroma, and properly spicy, exactly how it should be. The crispy fried egg with the creamy yolk on top was the perfect finishing touch. The plate was completely empty at the end. No surprise, the dish was simply too good. The place itself is small and straightforward, but that’s part of its charm. The awards on the wall make it obvious why this spot is so popular: they focus on the food, and the food delivers. If you’re looking for real, no-nonsense Pad Krapao in Bangkok, this is the place to go. Not Spicy, Not Eating ! :)

author: Daryl Lee
review_text: So yummy! Tried the pork and the beef. Both were good, but I think the pork is better. The eggs were fried to perfection. We were saving our stomachs for more food later, but definitely order more than one egg if you have the space for it! Overall, I will definitely be back! Easily something I would crave every now and then.

author: Samantha Pyq
review_text: If you like fried eggs with runny yolk, you will love this! Get more eggs, you wont regret. More expensive but portion is bigger than usual Thai portion. I will say the price is reasonable. Chicken was thinly sliced, lacked flavour, but was great after adding fish sauce. Pork was fantastic, bits of fat adding flavour. Beef was dry, get the pork instead. Level 2 seating is much cooler, because level 1 main door is always open for the ordering queue.

author: Curtis Bull
review_text: The best Pad Kra Pao I’ve had, ever. The level 4 spicy was a decent level of spice, not unmanageable in the slightest, next time I’ll try 5. It’s not a gimmicky “blow your socks off spice” that some YouTuber owned restaurants do. This place actually feels like they’re trying to serve you really amazing food without the frills of it being owned obviously by Mark Wiens. It’s genuinely great food at good prices, and the portion sizes are huge! All in all, this place deserves its 5/5 rating, truly. Can’t wait to go back

author: Amisha Ajay
review_text: I’d heard so much about how good Mark Wiens’ restaurant was, and I can say it absolutely lived up to the hype! I had the Thai basil chicken rice, spice level 3 (it goes up to 5), and it was so good. I’d 101% recommend it to anyone who loves spicy food 🔥 The flavour of the basil was hitting just right. I needed a Coke Zero to balance out that kick of spice haha, but you might not. The place itself is small and there was a bit of a queue when I visited, but the service was quick and efficient. I’m definitely coming back here for more next time I’m in town.

author: Loraine R.
review_text: Like Mark himself would say: ‘Wow!’ I ordered the chicken and beef, level 4 spicy and it was SPICY 🥵but really good! I preferred the chicken over the beef and they either forgot to bring half of the order or the beef took longer than the chicken to prepare, so had to ask where the rest of the order was. If you’re a party of multiple people, it would be nice to receive your order in 1 go. Other than that, definitely recommend!

author: Zhengmei Pongpun
review_text: Speaking as a Thai person, the basil stir-fry I had was just very ordinary nothing impressive and definitely not worth waiting an entire hour for. If I could turn back time, I wouldn’t have come to eat here; it felt like such a waste of my life. I decided to eat because the staff told me the wait would be only 40 minutes. At first, I wasn’t going to eat here, but then they said it would be about 35 minutes. In reality, though, I ended up waiting for an hour. That’s completely different from what they told me. And I couldn’t just leave because I had already paid, so I had to wait. You can see the time I paid on the bill and the time I got food on my phone When I finally got my food and took the first bite, it was just… meh. Not amazing, not impressive, nothing memorable at all. So I guess this is going to be the first time in my last time here.

author: Tazio Lai
review_text: Passed by many times and finally made it in today! Located very near the BTS Ekkamai station this place generally has a big line during meal times, but we made it in off peak so no wait whatsoever! Ordered the standard chicken version & of course with the fried duck eggs and it all came out quick, hot and delicious! Food taste, quality and quantity for the price and location are an absolute deal and great meal fix in a jam! They’ve got the merchandise game also locked down with stickers, caps, and even a football (soccer) displayed! Definitely worth a visit , just make sure you’re not too hungry if you go during peak hours as the wait might get you due to popularity!

author: Adnan Chowdhury
review_text: I was staying at an air bnb close by and passed this place once. It was busy with grab drivers so I could say it was popular. I ordered the chicken and beef jokes. I am not into spicy so I said no spicy. But after eating the food I felt it was too bland. So add ask for little spice. The food was very good. I liked the chicken more than the beef. Not a fan of duck egg though so I didn’t eat it. Service is fast and you have to do take out.

author: ben (Boboramen)
review_text: Q to order - after order wait outside for your table estimate 30min waiting (Thursday afternoon around 2pm) Service was easy they will ask on your prefer spicy level - 3 and above spicy - 2 and below average spicy For me spicy level 3 just nice, must order double duck egg original come with 1 add on 1 more. Those egg really amazed me with the crispy edge and creamy yoke Recommended to try, for trying you can order 1 plate for sharing. I notice also some customer order 1 plate each and only finish half or even less I suspect due to the heat. Dear people, please do not waste food! maybe you don’t care about the price or it’s not expensive to you but wasting food is really not cool.

author: thaichrislife
review_text: Highly recommended with fried squid! If you can eat spicy a little bit, level 4 is a best choice. Overall the environment is rush and small with little bit seats, food is tasty.

author: Shantanu Mishra
review_text: I got the vegetarian* spice level 5 - it wasn't nearly as spicy as I thought it would be but I did wish I had water because of the chillies. The dish itself wasn't spicy - it was the red chillies in it that were spicy. I wouldn't say it's the most delicious food I've had in Thailand but definitely the spiciest, yet. Got there at 1pm (Thursday) and was seated upstairs right after ordering. Got my food in about 10 minutes. Staff was really nice. Happy to try it once, wouldn't necessarily go out of my way to have it again. *Not sure if it's actually "vegetarian" since I think they use fish sauce in the food but I didn't ask because I didn't want to find out. Check before you order.

author: Torontoian_007
review_text: Wanted to visit since we watched from YouTube in Canada 🇨🇦. Saved the address n here we are. Medium spicy for Pad Kapong 😋. Mark Wien's (Foody YouTube) restaurant and something to remember. Self serv and pretty small place. We arrived there just b4 it's opened and we have a place to sit n enjoy the food.

author: Matthew Lee
review_text: Came here on a weekend lunchtime. Was almost close to noon and initially was worried I left late there would be a long queue for lunch but thankfully it wasn't crowded. There was no queue outside so I managed to enter into the shop. To my surprise 5 minutes later there was already a long queue and the queue stretched outside. Some people even after ordering had to wait outside for a seat. I admit I don't have a high threshold for spicy food, I wanted to order non spicy but decided to give very less spicy a try. After ordering was very quick to get a seat and the food was also served quite fast. The people around me seemed to not really enjoy it because they said it was too spicy to finish the whole plate. Some ate only a quarter or half of it. I was quite afraid but it wasn't that bad for me. I managed to clear the whole plate without much difficulty. Though I didn't order any drinks at first I had to get some water because once you get irritated by the spiciness it's kinda hard to continue as you will keep coughing so had to stop the irritation by drinking. Manageable but also sweated a bit. Thought I was weak but seemed there were people who were weaker than me and wanted to try it. Maybe will visit again next time and try the next level. I recommend bringing cash as I see they don't accept cards. Worth giving a try to judge for yourself.

author: 李志東
review_text: This was my second visit to the restaurant to try their spicy minced pork rice, as my first experience was delightful—the dish was served piping hot, and the rice was equally warm. However, during this visit, I encountered some issues. After a 20-minute wait, which I understand is reasonable given the crowd, I was disappointed to find that both the rice and the minced pork were lukewarm. It seemed as though they had prepared too many plates at once, resulting in them cooling down before serving. I believe there is room for improvement in the heating process. Additionally, I found the restaurant's layout to be quite cramped, and there was no clear queue management system in place. While I recognize this is a popular spot, effective management is essential to enhance the dining experience. I sincerely hope that my next visit will result in a hot and satisfying meal, as the flavors are genuinely worth returning for.

author: Reeve
review_text: This food was absolutely delicious! The flavors were perfectly balanced, and the ingredients tasted incredibly fresh. Egg was perfectly cooked. Prepare for traffic within the area, extra patience while waiting your seat and food! Price little bit higher than the usual amount. But its worth it.

author: Rokib Zimi
review_text: Crispy and delicious at Bonchon’s Chicken Fry, Bangkok! Absolutely loved our experience here! The Korean fried chicken is incredibly crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside — the flavors are bold and addictive. The sauces are spot on, especially the soy garlic and spicy glaze. The restaurant has a lively atmosphere and the staff were friendly and quick with service, even during busy times. Great place to enjoy flavorful fried chicken with friends or family. Highly recommend stopping by if you’re in Bangkok and craving something tasty! 🍗🔥🇰🇷

author: Owen Lim
review_text: This was a life-changing experience. Never ever in my 18+ years of life have I tasted quality of chicken as high as Bonchon Central World provided. The batter was crispy and just right, not too much and not overly-fried. NOT GREASY EITHER! It's also very pocket friendly. 589 Baht for 4 amazing drumsticks, 10 mouth-watering wings, 2 SUPERB sides and a generational chicken experience. Their Kimchi Coleslaw might be the greatest thing I ate alongside fried chicken, and I don't even like coleslaw. That's just how good it is! 10/10 would go here; cancel all your dinner plans and head here instead.

author: SK Katair
review_text: Bonchon at CentralWorld has tasty Korean fried chicken with a variety of flavors to choose from. The food is fresh, crispy, and flavorful. The restaurant is clean with a comfortable atmosphere, and the staff are nice and friendly. Always a good choice when I’m craving Korean fried chicken.

author: Chris P
review_text: This place feels like it should be fast food - not a sit-down experience. The chicken comes breaded and the flavors are good, but you might as well just order breading with sauce and skip the whole chicken thing. My fiancé got some kid of seafood bowl that she loved, but it reminded me of something from Pirates of the Caribbean

author: Natsu Gaara
review_text: Chicken was well made. Wanted to order some special set menus, but it was only for members. When asked if we could be members we were met with silence. Waitress English was not that great. Food was quite ok. 1L Coke came with a lot of ice, so tasted mostly water. Kitchen was quite efficient. Pricing was OK. They don't accept cash!

author: Moshi J.
review_text: Bonchon – The Crispy Korean Chicken Fix You Need 🍗🔥 When it comes to Korean fried chicken, Bonchon is the OG spot that never disappoints. With crispy skin, juicy meat, and that signature soy garlic glaze, it’s a must-visit for anyone craving legit KFC (Korean Fried Chicken, of course 😉). The restaurant is spacious, not too noisy, and service is attentive. Prices? Reasonable for the quality, but good luck stopping at just one order. What’s Worth Ordering? ✅ Soy Garlic Wings – The Gold Standard • Crispy, flavorful, and perfectly glazed—these are non-negotiable. • Pro tip: Skip the breast, go for wings or drumsticks. ✅ Kimchi Soup – Spicy & Soul-Warming • Bold, tangy, and packed with kimchi goodness. • Pro tip: Hydrate after—this one can leave you thirsty! ✅ Kimchi Noodle Soup – Smooth & Satisfying • Soft, tender Korean noodles in a spicy, umami-packed broth. • Pro tip: Eat it while it’s hot—don’t let the noodles get soggy! What’s Good About This Place? ✅ Best Korean Fried Chicken in Town – Perfect crunch, perfect flavor. ✅ Variety of Korean Comfort Food – Tteokbokki, bibimbap, ramen, you name it. ✅ Spacious Seating & Chill Ambience – Not too loud, great for casual dining. ✅ Attentive Staff – Quick service, friendly attitude. ✅ Late Ordering Hours – Order until 11 PM, stay until midnight. Anything to Improve? ❌ Kimchi Soup Can Be Dehydrating – Drink up! ❌ Chicken Breast Can Be Dry – Stick to wings or drumsticks. ❌ Can Get Crowded During Peak Hours – Come early to avoid long waits. Final Verdict – The Go-To Spot for Korean Chicken Lovers 🔥 Bonchon is the undefeated champion of crispy Korean fried chicken. Whether you’re here for the legendary soy garlic wings, the spicy kimchi soup, or just a chill meal with friends, this place delivers every time. 📢 Pro Tip: If you’re new here, start with the soy garlic wings. Then, if you’re feeling brave, level up with the spicy ones. 🌶️🔥

author: Hippo Poy
review_text: The service was trouble no body take Oder have to ask for Order. restaurant not rush hour on that time. the food come late have to ask for recheck the other

author: Km Y
review_text: If you are craving crispy chicken wings this should be your go to spot. They also have other items on their menu but their chicken is the best seller. Service was slow in this location but that’s expected since it’s inside a busy mall. Water is not free, you have to purchase bottled water. Price is very affordable and will fill you up.

author: Maryna Y.
review_text: A day ago, we just had been at the same restaurant in another province, and chicken there was more delicious than here, at Central World's branch. It was really surprising for us that the same chain of restaurants had different tastes and standards.

author: Pete Xouris
review_text: Great place for fried chicken and fried fish. Korean delicacies too can be found in the menu. A bit pricey though but deserves it.

author: Anthony
review_text: You ask if a dish is spicy or not. Waitress says no but... It is spicy. I didn't touch my meal. 300thb for nothing. Thanks.

author: Natasya Valerie
review_text: Located at 6th floor, the waitress can speak english so i don't have difficulty to order. The waiting time is about 15-20 minutes I ordered signature fried chicken with yangnyeom sauce, tasted good

author: icy iii
review_text: The server’s attitude was really bad, and they might have even insulted foreigners by calling them stupid. When I was checking out, I used GF Fried Chicken promotional voucher. It was a gift from a friend—two vouchers worth 2,000 baht in total—but I wasn’t very familiar with the promotion’s terms. My dine-in total was over 1,100 baht. I wanted to buy more fried chicken to reach 2,000 baht. However, the staff told me that only one voucher could be used per order. When she informed me of that, I immediately said I didn’t want to add anything else and took out cash to pay. So, it took me around 5 minutes to complete the payment. After everything was settled, I seemed to hear the cashier say the word “โง่ (ngô) ”to another staff

author: dhanywicaksono handoyo
review_text: Just like another fried chicken, nothing special, I was expecting to much with the sauce both of soy garlic or hot korean. The most terrible is the service, most waitress are passive, they throw their face to outside so they have reason to not seeing us, maybe they are lazy to get order from cuatomers. One specific waitress, I dont know what is her problem is, but I think she is rude, dont have good attitude. I think because she doesnt speak english fluently, doesnt want to explain clearly to foreigners about the menu, just want have quick task and then finish it. 👎👎👎👎👎

author: Kate B
review_text: Hate chicken legs! I order wings and they try to explain me 100 times that it's wings! Come on! You make me really sad and I have to pay for it! The worst BonChon branch I ever been. Never recommend to anyone.

author: Sirichai Jungsatit
review_text: The service was terrible, the workers acted like we were kids and we couldn’t read! Should really get fired. Not even a smile was spotted on their faces.

author: Hanuman Np
review_text: I visited Bonchon at CentralWorld and was really disappointed with the service. The restaurant was busy, but many staff members were just standing around, pretending to look busy without actually doing anything. Several came to our table multiple times to ask for our order, even though we had already placed it. It was clear that there was a serious lack of coordination and competence among the team. Unfortunately, the overall experience did not meet the standard I expect from Bonchon.

author: Vitchanart Sirising
review_text: Had dinner with my gf today around 7 pm. We ordered 4 pieces of chicken breast and 10 piece of wings. The chicken breast came out very fast while it took almost 30 min for chicken wings. The chicken breast tastes like it was cook for like a while already. Both plate smell and taste like old cooking oil. Both of us end up got upset stomach after.

author: a a
review_text: Delicious, and the waiters understand the orders, and the kitchen can deliver.

author: Supreme
review_text: NOT RECOMMENDED. Picture 1 is what i asked, picture 2 is what i received. They insist it's the same plate!

author: Roy Ong
review_text: A must try if you are ever in Pratunam Bangkok. I had both the dry and wanton soup noodle. Noodles are of a small portion but with generous amount of prawn wanton. I preferred the dry one over the soup.. Only 90 baht per bowl. I also tried the thai milk tea and green tea. Not bad but i tasted better… around 50 baht per cup. There is this Stir Pork with Basil. I ordered less spicy but damn the flavor is a bomb! I ate the entire basil on my own… and im not a big fan of basil. Worth to pay ard 280 baht for it.. the flavor is intense… a must try!! It located at the end of the alley. Small shop at the corner.. one of the staff there speaks English if you have trouble communicating in Thai.

author: Candy Neo
review_text: We stumbled upon this spot while exploring the area near Platinum Mall, and it was packed! The food is delicious, and we loved the value. The wonton noodles ($4.90) came with generous portions - three big prawn dumplings! The tom yum seafood noodles were also a highlight, with a rich and flavorful broth. Overall, a great find!"

author: Marie
review_text: Definitely recommend this, a good and cheap local spot. I got the pink tomyum noodles for 70 THB. The soup was like tomyum soup, the topping consisted of fishballs & some seafood. The service was fast too.

author: Thanh Phat Nguyen
review_text: First noodle shop i visited in Thailand and they don't let me down. There are a lot of different dishes so you can visit here day after day. I choose Tomyum and padthai, my friends have curry and basil rice, egg with crab etc... Everything is perfect except egg with crab lol. It's not so specical, but the price is really expensive so i don't really recommend that one. Everything else is perfectly fine.

author: Ars 3276
review_text: Used to be good the last time we had it 2 years back. Guess team has change as food is not good. Wanton was bad. Pork leg too fat and oily. We asked for less fats but i guess msg didnt went thrgh. Overall no good, period.

author: Alice Yeo
review_text: Located inside Pratunam market near glow hotel.. Not too far and difficult to find. Offered a varieties but we went for Wanton mee. The portion is bigger and the wanton has a big prawn inside which cost us 80bhat. A good local place to try with value for money and good food compare to the famous wanton mee stall. No q n fast serving. Will drop by again.

author: Tian hin Tai
review_text: This place is visitor friendly, their waiter do speak good enough english for your daily ordering. Food taste wise are general, but cleaniness good and feel safe at this alley while dining Good for a good quick grab while you are hungry. Enjoy your trip!!!

author: Adrian B
review_text: The best tasty food.. Wanton mee / noodles compared to the others ...reasonable amount of vegetable on the noddle bowl. Been here are few times, no regret coming here. Thanks Yok-Zod the Noodle

author: Ceres Ng
review_text: Saw this somewhere on YouTube or 小红书 and decided to come and try it. Taste ok, I like the soup. Ordered dried wanton mee and dry noodle. For dry noodle, they will ask you to choose noodle type. I would say for singaporean the taste is ok not those very unique type so safe for me as I don't like too unique. By the way the fried wanton is like fried wanton skin, not like singapore inside has meat or prawn.

author: Jessen Tan
review_text: Second time here. Stir fried vermicelli is good. Good place to eat after long shopping walk to catch up. Price is reasonable.

author: Philip Wong
review_text: Not bad. Good taste. Add your own Chilli for the spiciness you want. The wonton is great and tasty

author: Dennis Cheow
review_text: Will Recommend this Noodle shop then the famous 'unfriendly'. Food is good, same, 2 mouths finish it, but you can always add noodle for 20B. I str add 2 serving. With the dry chilli powder, everything taste the same. Cheerz Staffs is friendly. Kopi ice is good. The noodle really more worth then the "famous" 1.

author: TLC Cleaning Pty Ltd
review_text: When I come back to Bangkok, I always visit Yok Zod Great little noodle shop, quick, clean, and always value for money and also right in the heart of the markets

author: Arina Ong
review_text: It's located in the Pratunam Market. Delicious and a variety of choices.

author: Army Army
review_text: Love their soup noodles the most! Food: 5/5 Drink: Recommend the EstCola, only in Thai, good to try! Price: Ok

author: TAN JAY
review_text: Prices are shocking for a shop like this charges tourist prices and I don't understand the hype about it mostly patronised by tourists only taste is so average,there r so many stalls around it selling cheaper and better noodles and rice.

author: Q. Nhu Tran
review_text: please dont let the good review make you lose you money for bad food and bad service, we ordered and after 30mins they bring food, the food were too bad, hard and lots of spice... we lost 370baht for nothing, just bad foods. please dont come here

author: Yong Hwa Goo
review_text: Try if u like wanton noodles with Thai style. Braised pork is tasty and braised extremely well as it melts in your mouth.

author: Pang Jing Xuan
review_text: Food was nice . Ordered tomyam wonton and pork leg rice. Portion was slightly small

author: Christian Natan
review_text: Crab omelette for 590 bath like 1 egg only without crab meat, zonk!

author: Tan SR
review_text: The stall is located closely beside other stalls. There is only a small alley for patrons to queue and a table and 4xcounter seats. Ordered one with rice and without for additional pork. The fats does dissolve in your mouth, would recommend for those who like it.

author: Peiyi (Potato)
review_text: Dk is it dabao back left it for too long cold then the meat not tender alr so it tasted quite meh to me. Gravy wasn’t exceptional as well. A bit disappointed. But chilli is nice and made it nicer. Will be back to try it again on the spot next time. At first I actually tried the wrong stall, the one outside and it was so good (it turned out to be my fav of all) so I assumed this would be better since I saw it being highly raved on TT, so maybe that did raise my expectations a little more.

author: iamafoodtaster
review_text: A Humble Stall Along e Alley... Long Queue w Limited Table Seats So Most Of e Customers Request For Take Aways. Worth To Queue For First Try. Not A Bad Idea To Take Away~ 很家乡味。。。 I Personally Loves It As Compared w Sabx2!! Will Be Back Again 🤭🤭🤭

author: MJ
review_text: The best pork rice I had in BKK! The skin will melt in your mouth. Highly recommend to there around 7:30am before they sell out

author: Steven Wang
review_text: A street food which offer Chinese dish consists mainly of fragrant pork leg rice with choice of pork, pig skin, egg and some vegetable The pork leg taste is good. Chili sauce is just nice, not too spicy. Usually busy, both for dine in and take aways. The dining area in small alley, is for you to eat only, not that comfy if want to have a chat. Focus to enjoy the food. Highly recommended!

author: Lee Boon Kit
review_text: A humble eatery run by a lovely old couple, this place is a must-visit if you're in Thailand. The stewed pork leg rice is phenomenal! the meat is super tender, and their chili sauce is a must-try as it really hits the spot for me. However, the seats are very limited and I would recommend to be there early if you want to dine in. Its located in the heart of Pratunam Market. For a 70 bath meal, I say it's worth the try with it's quality and quantity being quite decent. Don't miss this place out if you plan to dropby in Bangkok!

author: Jane S
review_text: Visited this place twice during my trip, and it did not disappoint. The prices are reasonable, and the pork leg rice was absolutely delicious. The meat was tender, juicy, and packed with flavor. Also, the owner was generous with the portions, making it even more satisfying. Would recommend coming earlier as it can get quite packed later in the morning

author: MJ Kim Hee
review_text: I don't typically eat pork belly, but I accompanied my family to this restaurant since they wanted to try it and my dad loves pork leg very much. Luckily, they had a variety of dishes beyond pork belly! I opted for the wonton soup and noodles, and was pleasantly surprised by how delicious they were. The noodles had a great chewy texture and rich flavor without being oily. Highly recommended! Although I didn't try the pork belly, I did sample the lean meat and it was incredibly tender. The pork gravy was flavorful and paired perfectly with rice. The wait in line was worth it! Note: Be aware that outside food and drinks aren't allowed, so be sure to leave them at the designated rack outside the restaurant.

author: Wai Ling
review_text: This place near Pratunam/ Bangkok City has the most authentic taste of Thai style Pork Leg Rice. It is located along an alley, though not easy to find, and the place is very small, but it makes you feel like a local. The pork itself is very soft, and tastes great! The price is affordable and reasonable too (only 70 baht) Be sure to get there early as it sold out fast!

author: Sakthi Ganesh
review_text: This place is in a small alley. Don't trust Google maps directions. Anyway. The place can seat only 10-12 and it's pretty hot there. So you can either get a takeaway or wait for people to finish eating and dine in there. Whatever you choose don't miss out on the food. It's run by an old grandma and grandpa. So don't complain if things are slow either. Coming to the food, we ordered brazed pork knuckle with rice. It comes with some veggies, some pork fat, meat, rice and a boiled egg. You get condiments like chilli sauce, ground chillies with it. The meat was so juicy and tender and the fat was so gooy and gelatinous. A simple dish with a rich taste and a 5/5 for me. Each play costs 70 baht. There are also other options such as meat without rice and can cost up to 120 baht per plate depending on what you order.

author: Esther
review_text: This modest eatery exclusively caters to the breakfast crowd. The flavor here surpasses that of the usual tourist hotspots by a long shot. Rather than flocking to pricier, less authentic options, visitors should make a point to sample the genuine Thai pork leg rice here. It's truly exceptional! Oh and I love the chili!!

author: melson teo
review_text: awesome pork knuckle that melts in your mouth. we didn't get to eat it the day before because it was already sold out when we reached there. the staff keeper is so cute and kind, my wife got the change but dropped the 5 baht coin, she gave us another. the pork knuckle is so tender and flavorful. the rice is well cooked, each grain on its own. the chili is sweet and sour, goes very well with the pork knuckle. it was so crowded we had to pack it back to our hotel.

author: Chin Yan
review_text: A humble eatery owned by an old couple selling stewed pork leg rice. Located inside of the Pratunam morning market, very crowded and do expect some waiting as there’s not much sitting area. You may opt to takeaway. 70THB is a fair price but this place costs higher than other stewed pork leg place around the area, mostly found around 60THB. Be there early, they may sold out earlier than expected.

author: Victor
review_text: The food in this area is unbelievably delicious and costs around 60 baht. We tried many different stores and were never disappointed. Pork knuckles, crispy pork (you got to try this, mouthgasm), basil pork rice, omelette rice, the list goes on. We had breakfast here everyday, eating from all the stores.

author: 美人鱼のDiana yii
review_text: Famous because of their fair selling price and of course their braise pork is delicious. Sticky and doink doink. Haha. Outside all sell above 100 Thai bath per meal. Here only selling 70 Thai bath per meal.. Worth it. Come here for two consecutive days and always have customer queueing.

author: Charjen
review_text: Pork leg stew rice stall you can find in a rather tight alley of morning market in Pratunam. This is a gem find given its lower-than-competitive price and quality of food provided. The total downside is the number of seats available for dine in - less than 10 seats.

author: Z Y
review_text: Quite famous pork knuckle rice. Decent amount of tender meat to fats ratio, and does not have a strong porky smell, very bearable. Should dress light here; located in a tight street corner and share space with many other stalls.

author: Yun Yi Thiam
review_text: Pork knuckle was tender, delicious and flavourful. The fats to meat ratio were just right, really just melts in your mouth! No strong pork smell and very value for money! Enjoy it with their chilli for a much tasty bite! 70 baht for a bowl of goodness! Shop owners were really nice too. Will definitely come back again! :) Do note the place is very small so get it to go if you don’t want to wait.

author: SM S
review_text: So good!!! We found this place purely by chance.. the initial wanton noodle place we wanted to go to was closed so further search landed us here and food did not disappoint! Meat was juicy and tender, and the fats melt in your mouth! Love it! It's in a very small tight alleyway, so you have to walk further in to find it. Shop's run by a lady and an elderly man. So please be patient. Tables are also very limited but the turnover is very fast!

author: Chin Boon
review_text: My No.1 street food in Thailand !! Her pork knuckles rice is the best authentic taste I ever tried, the sauce was pretty yum and the meat will totally melt inside your mouth !! I don’t mind to sit here every once a week to enjoy this meal !!

restaurant: ข้าวขาหมูอินเตอร์ (โกชิว) เจ้าเก่า สูตรโบราณดั้งเดิม
author: Notorious
review_text: My first review in Thailand, more specifically Hatyai. This is a famous spot for pork and rice (Go Chew). The staff are all very friendly and welcoming. Ordering is no problem if you speak Mandarin. The roast pork is crispy and tasty, while the braised pork with eggs and vegetables is tender and flavorful—best enjoyed with rice since it’s on the salty side. The chicken is pretty decent as well, comes with special condiments. Prices are quite reasonable for the quality. Definitely worth a try!

restaurant: ข้าวขาหมูอินเตอร์ (โกชิว) เจ้าเก่า สูตรโบราณดั้งเดิม
author: κεηηγsκ
review_text: One senses from the name alone a promise of heritage: “The Original, Traditional Recipe. The star of the show is, of course, the stewed pork leg, beautifully tender and perfectly balanced in flavor. You can choose to have it served whole or chopped, though most diners seem to prefer the latter. However, the real surprise is the roasted pork belly, the unexpected hero, delightfully crispy, flavorful, and generously portioned. Despite the holiday crowd, our dishes arrived quickly, and the staff were friendly and spoke Mandarin, which was super helpful. Oh, and the black iced coffee? Absolutely loved it!

restaurant: ข้าวขาหมูอินเตอร์ (โกชิว) เจ้าเก่า สูตรโบราณดั้งเดิม
author: Goh Jun Wen
review_text: Decent food but I've tasted much better ones. Portion is big and generous, total 1270 baht for 6 people including drinks. Service is okay, food is served fairly quickly. Alot of tourists.

restaurant: ข้าวขาหมูอินเตอร์ (โกชิว) เจ้าเก่า สูตรโบราณดั้งเดิม
author: david chong
review_text: The signage at the stall front says Ko Chew so do make sure you’re at the right place. The pork leg comes in 3 sizes. So does the crispy pork and chicken depending on the party size. Decent pork leg that comes with hard boiled eggs on the side. The crispy pork is also good. Popular place for tourists, mainly Malaysians.

restaurant: ข้าวขาหมูอินเตอร์ (โกชิว) เจ้าเก่า สูตรโบราณดั้งเดิม
author: Joex JF
review_text: 3 dishes small size for 460 baht, flavourful and too much for 2 person, very friendly staff, they speak chinese and english

restaurant: ข้าวขาหมูอินเตอร์ (โกชิว) เจ้าเก่า สูตรโบราณดั้งเดิม
author: yunzen96
review_text: Super delicious! On holidays, there’s a small queue of about 30 minutes. The dishes come out pretty quickly. Seven people spent 1,440 THB. Compared to the braised pork leg, I love the crispy pork belly even more. This is the best roast pork I’ve ever had!!!

restaurant: ข้าวขาหมูอินเตอร์ (โกชิว) เจ้าเก่า สูตรโบราณดั้งเดิม
author: Samuel Main
review_text: This is probably quite a nice stew pork leg place, but unfortunately I tasted better one so I’m gonna give it a 4 star as it is still considered quite good. The staff is very helpful as well.

restaurant: ข้าวขาหมูอินเตอร์ (โกชิว) เจ้าเก่า สูตรโบราณดั้งเดิม
author: Emeline Koh
review_text: Just the normal kind of atmosphere at any of the coffee shop in Thailand. Nothing really special about the ambience there. The food is just normal. Nothing really very fantastic about the pork leg. But the roasted pork is not a bad choice because it’s really quite crispy. Worth the calories to eat the roasted pork. For the pork leg, I think the braised is not good enough for the taste which I think I have eaten better ones in Bangkok.

restaurant: ข้าวขาหมูอินเตอร์ (โกชิว) เจ้าเก่า สูตรโบราณดั้งเดิม
author: Crayon Lum
review_text: Highly recommend the crispy pork here, juicy and crispy, big portions, and it best matches with their homemade chili sauce which is super appetising. Every dish is reasonable and decent. The staff is friendly and they speak mandarin well. Beware of peak hour (after 10am) and the seat are limited.

restaurant: ข้าวขาหมูอินเตอร์ (โกชิว) เจ้าเก่า สูตรโบราณดั้งเดิม
author: jejakjejak
review_text: One of my favorites place for breakfast or brunch. Generous serving. Braised Pork Throttle is superb. Tasty and tender. Roasted Pork is crunchy and juicy. There are many places in Hatyai selling similar food but this place has my thumbs up.

restaurant: ข้าวขาหมูอินเตอร์ (โกชิว) เจ้าเก่า สูตรโบราณดั้งเดิม
author: Vling Chong
review_text: 真心好吃😋 This pork leg rice is delicious and so lucky no long wait for me even lunch time 😊 Their service is good and serve fast , very efficient service . Their crispy pork is so delicious and crunchy. Definitely will visit again next time go Hatyai again☺️

restaurant: ข้าวขาหมูอินเตอร์ (โกชิว) เจ้าเก่า สูตรโบราณดั้งเดิม
author: KH (Alson)
review_text: The pork knuckles rice are flavourful. Juicy and tender. Must order the rice for it. Soup can be exempted from it as it tastes below average.

restaurant: ข้าวขาหมูอินเตอร์ (โกชิว) เจ้าเก่า สูตรโบราณดั้งเดิม
author: C. G
review_text: The pork leg rice here is super authentic, the meat’s really soft and tender. It can get a bit hot and crowded, but the wait isn’t too bad. Kinda sad I missed the roast pork though, so come early if you want that! Staff were polite and looked happy, chatting and smiling as they worked.

restaurant: ข้าวขาหมูอินเตอร์ (โกชิว) เจ้าเก่า สูตรโบราณดั้งเดิม
author: Raymond Beh
review_text: The pig trotter and pig leg is must have. The dishes here are not as salty as compare to the stalls out there. Price are reasonable too. Staff service are amazing. Do order their chinese tea, good to cleanse away the oily after taste.

restaurant: ข้าวขาหมูอินเตอร์ (โกชิว) เจ้าเก่า สูตรโบราณดั้งเดิม
author: Grace Ong
review_text: Aroiiiiii, very nice food and the roasted pork is super crispy, the rice smell and taste good, I will definitely miss it!

restaurant: ข้าวขาหมูอินเตอร์ (โกชิว) เจ้าเก่า สูตรโบราณดั้งเดิม
author: celine hng
review_text: Food is just okay, nothing special. Tourist prices—small braised pork leg + roasted pork + 2 drinks = 350 baht. A bit pricey for what you get.

restaurant: ข้าวขาหมูอินเตอร์ (โกชิว) เจ้าเก่า สูตรโบราณดั้งเดิม
author: Elaine L
review_text: Really flavorful braised pork rice which is not too salty. The clear fishball soup with seaweed is also good and pairs really well with the pork rice. Portion is also good. This must be a local favorite as there are both locals and tourists dining here. Lots of people here even during breakfast time.

restaurant: ข้าวขาหมูอินเตอร์ (โกชิว) เจ้าเก่า สูตรโบราณดั้งเดิม
author: Victor Khoo
review_text: A bit overrated and expensive now due to its popularity with tourists. I came here many years ago when there are more locals eating here than tourists. That’s a shame as you don’t get that authentic feel anymore.

restaurant: ข้าวขาหมูอินเตอร์ (โกชิว) เจ้าเก่า สูตรโบราณดั้งเดิม
author: Jenny Loo
review_text: Real delicious braised Pork leg, Roast Pork Fish Ball sea weed soup especially Thai tea 😋😋

restaurant: ข้าวขาหมูอินเตอร์ (โกชิว) เจ้าเก่า สูตรโบราณดั้งเดิม
author: JE N
review_text: No prices on the menu. A 3 person portion cost us about 180baht. It’s affordable but I would feel more comfortable in ordering if everything is more transparent. However, drinks do come w a price tag at 20baht, so why not for food?

author: Khay Yin Tang
review_text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I was pleasantly surprised to find that this restaurant is entirely staffed by women, including the chefs! The atmosphere was welcoming, and the food was absolutely delicious. Every dish I tried was full of flavor and beautifully presented. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great dining experience!

author: Chow Stephen
review_text: Open kitchen concept, surprisingly all female employees from front desk till kitchen. We arrive is queue outside prepare chair for waiting, while waiting let you view menu and take order, mention to ours 20mins, after seating clean up the dishes are serve direct, manage well on timing. Kem som taste normal spicy, Egg omelette nice Fried pork belly garlic nice Broccoli with shrimp nice Pepper ginger pork slices taste good Petai Shrimp very nice. NON-HALAL Not plenty of parking lot Environment clean and neat Price cheap 6dishes with 7pax 705baht Highly recommend

author: Notorious
review_text: First dinner here on my trip. The first thing you notice is the huge window into the kitchen, where it looks like an all-female team of chefs is at work. The food is tasty, well-seasoned, and flavorful. Communication is easy too—no problem with English here.

author: C J
review_text: I loved their tomyam, spiciness at the very nice level. I ordered shrimp tomyam, it comes with 6 medicum sized shrimps and the portion is good for 2 people. Waitresses are friendly and helpful by offering chairs while waiting to be seated inside. Parking is not hard to find.

author: Supat Limsakul
review_text: The food is delicious, flavorful, and the portions are generous. The ingredients are of high quality. The service is fast and efficient.

author: Li Yuen
review_text: Tried this Thai restaurant and really enjoyed it! The fried seabass with chilli sauce was slightly spicy and tasty with a nice crunch, but the tom yum soup was definitely our favourite… so flavourful and comforting. Will be back again!

author: Elanggo Krishnan
review_text: Shop is very clean. Tomyam seafood taste great. Sea fish not fresh but cooking flavor taste well. Stir Fried Seafood with Curry Powder taste good too. Basil Pork moderate taste.

author: yin jia goh
review_text: Nice food with reasonable price👌😋 but I think tomyum soup can be more spicy abit

author: Chong Lip
review_text: Very nice Authentic Thai Food! Best in Hatyai!!! Michelin standard! 😍😋👏🏻👏🏻👍🏻 In summary, best of the rest!😋👏🏻👏🏻👍🏻

author: Jeff Chua
review_text: Food is nice. Service is good. Got English menu available. Price reasonable

author: Stacey K
review_text: Another pleasant surprise. A restaurant we went after seeing long queue outside the restaurant for a few days. Good and cheap Thai dishes. Dishes portion more suitable for 1-2 pax

author: Aves Khiung
review_text: Good foods. Place is clean. Open kitchen with many staffs. Foods are served very quick after order, maybe due to at least 7 staffs in the kitchen.

author: Kuan Fung Chin
review_text: Friendly staffs, fast service, good food, reasonable price

author: EWE DE LUNN
review_text: Loved by the local, the food very nice, tomyum can choose the spiciness, fried vegetables good to taste, fried squid is a must!!

author: Lee Hoon Loh
review_text: One of the best local Thai Food restaurants ever tried compare to those other over high rated restaurants, this one very good 👍🏻

author: Wen Chien Cheang
review_text: We ordered these dishes for 4 adults. More than enough, love the big portion served. They had an open kitchen, the kitchen is clean, able to watch the chef cooking performance too. Noticed most of the chefs are women, the staff were friendly too. Most importantly, the dishes were cheap, value for money.

author: Sujie Won
review_text: Nice place to have some simple Thai Food😋. Tom yam is spicy 🌶️ the veggie is the best especially I love the Kailan 👍👍👍. Will visit again 😉

author: CS Lim
review_text: taste very nice with reasonable price. need to queue, but won't wait too long

author: Mauricio
review_text: Ordered a curry paste chicken ala carte, and frankly it was disappointing. The chicken were small fragments of bone with tiny slivers of meat. Taste-wise it was ok, nothing out of the ordinary. Poor value.

author: Peter Tan
review_text: Good place to eat. affordable price, clean and new. thai and Chinese style cook food

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: EXOL & NCTzen
review_text: Too many options of what to eat from their fresh seafood, fishballs section, meats, ready to eat food, their desserts and more. Overall food here is very good and delicious. The seafood is fresh. U can either cook yourself or ask them to cook for you. There are some you can make to order just have to let them know your table. Their drinks also have many options. Service is also very good. Just that if u are not local, u may need to go by ehailing as it’s quite far from the main city. Recommend to try. We all came out full and happy.

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Bordin Jindawattanawong
review_text: This is one of the best mid-to-high-range buffets in the city. I loved that many dishes were cooked-to-order rather than sitting under heat lamps, which kept everything tasting fresh and premium. We decided to go for the 498 Baht seafood package instead of the basic tier, and for the most part, it was excellent value. However, the reason I’m not giving it a full 5 stars is that I was really expecting to see fried mantis shrimp with garlic on the menu for this price point, but unfortunately, they didn't serve it.

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Teng Sook Yin
review_text: Wide range of food and varieties. Given 2 charcoal stoves. One for Mookata and for BBQ. Can choose to cook ourselves or ask them to cook, especially the larger items like fish and crabs. The seafood is fresh. The salt grilled fish was delicious. Just the environment was very hot due to heat from the stoves. But that is expected I guess. Not all areas can be installed with fans. Still enjoyed the meal.

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Ju Nguyen
review_text: The diversity of the food, the food freshness, the service, the outdoor atmosphere, everything is excellent if you have a big stomache.

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: W T
review_text: Visited what I’d call the best seafood mookata spot I’ve tried in Hat Yai, and it was an unforgettable experience. At around 500+ baht per person, the price is slightly higher than most local barbecue places, but I personally feel it’s worth every baht for the quality and variety offered. The seafood selection was outstanding — fresh river prawns, squid, clams, and fish, all prepared perfectly for grilling. What makes this place unique is a special section where you can hand over your chosen raw ingredients for the staff to cook according to your preferred style, which adds a personal touch to the meal. I focused mainly on the seafood, which was flavorful and fresh, while my companion sampled the meat and felt it wasn’t quite on par with the seafood. Still, for anyone craving a satisfying seafood mookata experience in Hat Yai, this spot is definitely a must-try.

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Eskimo 0308
review_text: 25feb25.Anybody wanna join me tonight? I am solo traveler. Finally manage to taste the food. Value for money. Many dishes didn't try because I solo dining. Next trip will come with friends. The staff polite and friendly. So sad as 8pm they stop service prawn cooked vermicelli.

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Jess Lim
review_text: No time limit, you can eat from 4pm to 11pm Extensive selection of seafood, dessert, vegetables and meat. You get to choose the cooking style for the seafood you have chosen. The waitress cleaned up the table and refilled the food on time. Not air-conditioned but the place has good ventilation.

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Yuri Tan
review_text: Worse experience ever do not eat here if Yr here, here's recap on my part, my family was trying to enjoy the buffet yes we ordered the normal package we payed around 300baht, but when we eating the next table besides us ordered the package that includes premium seafood, they offered my family a crab, and and then the workers came by and warned me us once tht we can't eat the seafood, Ok look BUT is the table next to us offering to us, and then the second time the worker comes and they did not say anything about they will charge my family table extra 298 baht just because OF ONE CRAB that the other table offered, they also stated they will charge if they seen us taken the item BUT the sign they pointed at IS NOT FOR THE PRICING that they gonna charge if anyone taken the seafood

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: yow suen tho
review_text: Quite extensive seafood if early. If late, also still well stocked. But place quite large -about 100 tables so getting to the raw food material to cook is quite a way to go if not seated towards center.

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Daniel L
review_text: Huge assortment of seafood and meat options. Indoor seating is warm, outdoor seating is cooler but is not shaded. 498 baht per pax for access to all seafood and meat options. Grilled whole fish, horseshoe crab roe salad among the selections. Seafood were all fresh.

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Valentino Tan
review_text: what i like about this place is i can choose my own fish and let them cooked the style that is being offered. Theres 20 options for a variety of seafood, fish, prawns, shells. big fat prawn and fish theres 2 charcoal pot, one for grilled one mookata style. the salt fish with lemongrass inside is nice. this place good as i can smoke. its in the open

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Leia
review_text: We arrived at 4:30 PM and found several vans already there. This is an open-air restaurant without air conditioning. The seafood buffet is priced at THB498 per adult and THB198 per kid. The sheer variety of food is overwhelming. The seafood is fresh. You have three options: order and have it cooked for you, choose from their ready-to-eat dishes, or grill the food yourself. There's no time limit for dining. Worth to try it.

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Joey Ng
review_text: Best of both worlds, where local Thai style dishes and Thai mookata can be experienced in one location. Seafood choices was plentiful, styles of cooking was variable too. Choose to grill or Mookata your way through the extensive food choices of meat and seafood or pick your choice for them to cook up a pretty legit Thai style dish. Side dishes, local dessert, ice cream, fruits and drinks choices were awesome too. THB 498 per pax is such an awesome deal, with Eat All You Can No Time Limit. Only suggestion for improvement is the condition of their chairs which can be improved in terms of cleanliness. Plenty of parking.

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Toto Ong
review_text: Fully recommended moo-ka-taa buffet with exquisite seafood selection like a seafood market. 498baht per person with unlimited time. Must come early to take your Q number. Plenty of car park provided.

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Eric TJF
review_text: One of the famous all-you-can-eat buffet in Hatyai with seafood package priced at only 498 thai baht per person. Accept Malaysia national QR payment method as well; easy and convenient, no cash is required 👍 Be sure to be at here earlier during weekends as it's quite pack

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Katrina Felix
review_text: Nice food, worth the price. It’s naturally ventilated so it can be warm. Seafood all fresh. There’s a combination of cooking it yourself and selecting the seafood and the restaurant cooking it for you. Either way , all delicious. I forgot to take the fresh uncooked seafood but you can see from all the photos shared on google reviews- still the same now. I recommend you give it a try when you’re in Hatyai!

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Ong Lieh Yan
review_text: Seafood galore!!! Fresh seafood everywhere and many types to choose from too. Was impressed with some fresh big sized fishes there. Even the bigger sized squids are available. Meaty section is there too. Provided with one Thai hotpot and a charcoal grill. You can cook your own or ask them to cook for you. Desserts from shaved ice to ice cream. Definitely a must-go to place when you are in Hat Yai. My personal recommendation: Go for the seafood AND most important ask them to cook!! 😀

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Yenestc Lim
review_text: This is super nice experience! Variety of choice, pork leg very nice, seafood very fresh, non stop to top up from staff! Need to book in advance for better reserve of table! Worth with money gave!

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Cher Ong
review_text: Very spacious area for seafood buffet & mookota. I'm here just for the cooked seafood as I'm too lazy to bbq it on my own. It's way more convenient & save the work and heat. There are a lot of seafood variations & other side items. Dessert, salad & drinks are also available. It's definitely worth the money even if you're not with a big appetite.

restaurant: Buffet Rimnam Mookata And Seafood Hatyai
author: Peekaboo
