review_text: Eat all you can!! Great choices of fresh seafood and meat!! For tourists you will be offered many local Thais cuisine, so eat all you can! Make sure you bring empty stomach so its worth your money 🤩🤩 They offer payment via both cash and QR (non Thai can use TnG etc) Toilets can be improved 🙂🙂

author: Ida Jørgensen
review_text: U ordered your food, get upstairs and give your ticket to the waitress, find an empty seat she will give u your food and drink in just a second. This restaurant only serve bun (cold dishes). The food is really good at local price. The restaurant looks "ok", meaning u can see napkins on the floor here and there, but the tables were clean. Question is, would I be back to eat at this restaurant? Definitely yes, the food is so good.

author: LexTeo8888
review_text: Was trying to find the roast pork Banh mi and when I saw a long queue at this eatery, silly me thought this was it. Halfway through I realised they were selling grilled meats and vermicelli and decided why not. Ordered a full set plus an additional plate of grilled meat and iced tea for VND76,000...which was very reasonable as there were proper seating and fans (no Aircon as per norm). Was abit disgruntled when I was served the meats which were not even warm but all my disappointment disappeared when I tried my first taste. It was really not bad for a 4.1 Google rating. Not mind-blowing but I got my money's worth for sure! What got me swooning was the chilli mixture that you put together with the fish sauce dipping. It was spicy 🔥 but in a good way! Really elevated the dining experience from not bad to good! Gave only 4 stars though as this is Vietnam and I have higher expectations whereas if this was served to me in Singapore...maybe 4.5.

author: Stephen Romans
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Kieu Bao Barbecue Rice Noodles was one of the best meals I had on this trip—I loved it so much I went back twice. They have an easy-to-read English menu, which makes ordering simple, but it still feels like a very local spot. The prices are incredible for the quality. The rice noodles with pork and spring roll are absolutely amazing and ended up being my favorite meal of the entire trip. A must-try if you’re in the area!

author: Manuel Dresselmann
review_text: We found this place on Google looking for foodplaces to be in the City. We almost passed the Shop since downstairs looks more like a garage for motorbikes than a Restaurant. At a very small counter you order your mal which is either grillen pork, minced pork or springrolls in a combination with glass noodles and greens. You can also mix it for a combination of All 3 Extras. If you wish for more noodles additions are free. After your order you can go upstairs, take a seat and wait for your order to arrive. The dining area is very minimalistic which gives the place a unique feel. The food is what it is all about. A whole 2 liter Bucket of "nuoc mam" the local fish sauce makes the dish. Its fresh, its well made and screams "umami". We enjoyed it a lot.

author: Norbert
review_text: AMAZING PLACE. The prices are totally local and the food is delicious. The staff is super nice, too. Heads up for Europeans/Americans: I’d recommend ordering extra spring rolls or meat. The portions are 'Vietnamese style,' but honestly, even if you order 3 portions, the price is still low 😅. Highly recommend!! I came here 2 days in a row!

author: Fred Jaeger
review_text: You have to order first and pay. It was the best price value for you can get here. I was a bit worried about the salad cleanliness tho. Let's see in a few days Nuoc mam was good. Everything was good. Sometimes you have bikes in here though because of delivery. 33k vnd for 1 bowl

author: Sarah C
review_text: Food was super affordable and delicious. Seating is upstairs and it can get quite hot in the Viet heat but that’s normal with no AC. The sauces were in a giant pail which was amazing, you could use as much as you wanted. The fresh leaves were amazing to eat with your main. 10/10 would come back. Cash only btw!

author: Angeline Ng
review_text: Want a simple hearty meal with bbq pork and spring rolls. It’s certainly a local joint , for a moment u would think it’s a bike shop however the place has so many bike inside for Grab delivery collectors and Patrons to ride and dine. Seats are also available upstairs, so it's really nice and clean for just a quick Bún Thịt Nướng (Vietnamese Grilled Pork & Rice Noodles) Cheap and good spot to come to for a quick meal. Will definitely come back

author: V. L. (VonMeetsWorld)
review_text: I visited Kiều Bảo in October 2025. The bowl of Bún Thịt Nướng from Kiều Bảo is a beautiful expression of Saigon’s everyday artistry — humble, balanced, and quietly confident. The white rice noodles forming a soft cloud at the base; golden spring roll resting on one side; charred pork slices and grilled pork patties spread over the top; crushed peanuts scattered like tiny jewels; a small nest of pickled carrots and scallions providing color and bite. The grilled pork — smoky, slightly caramelized, with visible grill marks — carries that unmistakable aroma of lemongrass and fish sauce that instantly awakens your appetite. Each bite has that sweet–savory contrast the Vietnamese have perfected: first the gentle crunch of the seared surface, then the tender, juicy meat that almost melts. Then there’s the chả giò — the fried spring roll — crisp and golden on the outside, shattering audibly with the first bite. The basket of lettuce and cucumber is crisp and cool, almost dewy, cutting through the richness of the meat. When you tear the greens with your fingers and fold them into the bowl, they bring everything to life — suddenly, the dish feels lighter, brighter, and more alive. Finally, when you pour over the nước chấm (fish sauce dressing), the whole bowl transforms. For my full review, do check out my video diary in my YouTube Channel!

author: Jesus Estrada
review_text: Tried a few days ago for a late lunch but they were out of spring rolls so I left and came back. The first time, the register lady was dismissive. This time, the register lady was kind. The staff are helpful. There is a menu with pictures and English descriptions. The price is really affordable. The meal was really good. The minced pork was ok, and the grilled pork was great, if not a little dry. The spring rolls are on the small side but crispy and tasted pretty good. One bite had an off flavor, but the rest of everything was very tasty. Paid in cash. Will return.

author: Hà Minh Dũng
review_text: super affordable and good value for money. staff super nice n cute. thats why they full all the time. taste is good compare to price. order a full bowl will cost roughly 1.5 usd. with first free refill of veggie and rice noodle. this restaurant is super cool in this area

author: Julie Xiao
review_text: I came after being recommended by a local. You order at the cashier downstairs and they deliver your order to your table upstairs. This place specializes in bún thịt nướng which is grilled pork served over vermicelli noodles with fresh herbs, vegetables, and fish sauce. I like that they give you a bucket (yes, a literal bucket) of nước chấm (fish sauce). It's super affordable ($1) and it's very filling especially if you get two spring rolls. I would definitely recommend!

author: Chi Pham
review_text: This place was introduced to me as a popular tourist spot, so it was understandably quite busy. The ordering process was a bit confusing ay first - you have to order and pay at the counter, then choose a seat and wait for someone to collect your receipt and prepare your food. The process could definitely be streamlined. Service and hygiene weren’t the best, but I’d still recommend it as a fairly healthy, reasonably priced and light meal option.

author: Wasurat Niyomrat
review_text: This restaurant doesn’t have a huge menu, but it serves simple Vietnamese dishes that are incredibly delicious no matter how they’re prepared. The fresh vegetables are refillable for free, which I really appreciated. I wish they had a branch in Thailand! In conclusion, I highly recommend this place. 🧡🧡🧡

author: Nicholas Lim
review_text: This place deserves more than Michelin Guide. Superb food at unbelievable prices. Spring rolls are insanely good (spring rolls > grilled pork). You must try this place if you are in Saigon. The locals absolutely love this place and the prices are just too cheap for such a heavenly bowl of perfection. Each bowl comes with a hearty amount of greens and the big bucket of fish sauce is at your disposal. Add however much to your liking. 1) Order your meal at the counter 2) Pay with cash only and receive a receipt for your order 3) Pass the receipt to the kitchen for your meal 4) Sit back at your table and wait to be served

author: Deon Jong
review_text: A must try in HCM. Local restaurant with delicious spring roll with grilled meat. Pairedwith vermicelli and crush peanuts for additional texture. Pour some house made fish sauce concoction into your meal and enjoy!

author: Cong He
review_text: We were recommended this spot from our tour guide and its a definite must visit, local vibes with many bike delivery drivers able to ride their bikes into the store to pick up orders. The food was out fast and fresh, the signature BBQ rice noodles were delicious, it had a good portion and the spring roles were cripsy with a generous filling

author: Dana Kizer
review_text: One of our favorite restaurants on our visit to Saigon. The menu is limited but the food is delicious! This is the closest dish to what Americans call vermicelli in the states. A tour guide recommended this restaurant and it did not disappoint. It is extremely casual but the food is excellent. You order at the counter and pay, they give you a sign to put on your table, an employee will get your receipt from you at the table and then bring the food to you. Remember to use this fish sauce. There is a large bucket on each table with small bowls for you to scoop it into. There are also diced peppers on the table to add to it if you like it spicy.

author: Rene Shin
review_text: I think these foods at this price would be perfect for everything. It was really delicious.

author: Carl Shi
review_text: Great local casual food shop, friendly and helpful staff. The location is in a narrow and very busy street. the BBQ sausage(minced pork) and BBQ pork pieces are quite tasty. The rice noodles are fresh, the bucket of pre-made fish sauce are just season to taste. Free refill rice noodles which is good for big eaters. For 30,000 Dung is an absolute bargain! Worth to go and have one.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: SERA RUTH
review_text: If you're craving authentic Korean cuisine in Ho Chi Minh, look no further than Doran Doran. This charming spot offers a clean and welcoming atmosphere, making it an excellent choice for lunch or dinner. The restaurant is not overly noisy, providing a peaceful and relaxing dining experience. One standout feature is the precision of their lunch sets, which are well-balanced and satisfying. You’ll get a good variety of dishes that reflect true Korean flavors. The portions are generous and well thought out, perfect for anyone looking to enjoy a fulfilling meal without feeling overwhelmed. What truly adds to the experience is the hospitality — the boss, a kind Korean person, oversees the restaurant, ensuring everything runs smoothly and guests feel at home. The staff is friendly and attentive, adding to the welcoming vibe of the place.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Sebastian Estores
review_text: This was soooooo good. Every bonchon was perfect, the bibimbap comes in a hot stone, and everything tastes how it should. No shortcuts in any of the foods they prepared. I recommend going with many people, as even the lunch set was a LOT of food. The cinnamon dessert was also a really interesting experience. I could go on and on but just try it. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Jamie Newell
review_text: Super tasty food for a reasonable price. 8 side dishes offered complimentary with the main. Would highly recommend coming!

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Huỳnh Lê Thiên Ý
review_text: The atmosphere is super laid-back, and the food is absolutely tasty! Plus, there are endless refills of yummy banchan and free ice cream to enjoy.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Anais Lim
review_text: From the guidance to the seating after entering to the free ice cream dessert at the end, all the food was good. We especially enjoyed the galbi seafood stew. The side dishes were seasoned just right, it was clean, and the staff was friendly, so I had a pleasant dinner.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Võ Ngọc May Thảo
review_text: Good place to have great time with friends. Korean food is good, perfect service. The owner is really nice and supportive. You will want to return. Picture is when we finished all. Nothing left.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Philip Hoang
review_text: Love this restaurant. The food is amazing and value for money. They even have free ice cream at the end of the meal, but we were already so full. Also our waiter Nhat Huy was amazing. My mum twisted her ankle earlier in the evening and he was so great and gave us a make shift ice pack so my mum could put it on her ankle. Would recommend this restaurant to anyone.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Oisín Dolan
review_text: Extremely friendly place. Great food and selection with combos that let you get a few different things to taste. Would be brilliant for a group Try the cinnamon tea. Never had it before and it's such a nice refreshing sweet end to a meal that won't leave you feeling full

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Michael Ruhwedel
review_text: We had a fantastic Bibimbap. The rice was crispy from the hot bowl. Vegetables fresh with very tasty mushrooms. The egg cooked to perfection. It was the best Bibimbap I had ever eaten. The appetizers were diverse and very flavorful. The kimchi tasted spicy and extraordinarily well. The staff provided impeccable service. They were attentive and proud of their restaurant. We were gifted a cold bean sprout soup and mochi ice cream. This left us refreshed and with a feeling of having been very lucky to have found this place.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: YONGJUN SONG (JUN)
review_text: I recently visited this Korean restaurant in Ho Chi Minh City, and it was a great experience! The food tasted just like home — especially the kimchi stew and bulgogi, which were both delicious and full of flavor. The staff were friendly and attentive, and the place had a cozy, welcoming vibe. I’ll definitely come back again. Highly recommend if you’re craving authentic Korean food in Vietnam!

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Thuy Ly
review_text: One of the best place for cold noodle and bbq in Saigon. I cam here 3 years ago and this time the flavor is still the same 🥰

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Yoon Sung_YS Kim, (YS)
review_text: Korean restaurant owned and managed by Vietnamese. 1. The taste and services were good enough. 2. The price was reasonable. 3. The location is a bit 애매하다

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Ali Taghipour
review_text: I went for a combo for two at this Korean restaurant, and as I’m writing this review, I’m about to burst! 😂 It’s a 3-course meal with tons of side dishes—easily enough for three people. From the mouthwatering BBQ to bibimbap and kimchi, everything was fresh, flavorful, and top-notch. 🌶️😋 Portions are huge, and even if you’re not that hungry, you’ll keep eating because it’s just that good!

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Quyen Nguyen
review_text: It is not close to authentic Korean food yet, we ordered 3 dishes, gimbap, kimchi fried rice, and tteokbokki, total 500k vnd. -I have nothing to say about the gimbap (8/10) -The kimchi fried rice is bland and needs more kimchi taste in it. Also it looks nothing like the picture on the menu! (6/10) -For tteokbokki (6.5/10), the rice cake was overcooked and was too soft. The rice cake needs to be a bit more chewy. The fish cake, on the other hand, needs to be cooked a bit longer..... I had to wait until the tteokbokki got cold for the texture to become better. I ordered kimchi fried rice and asked them to add no pork in it but they added pork sausage so it took them another 15 minutes to remake it for us, other than that the service and atmosphere were good . The ginger tea at the end was refreshing 😁

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Vy Duong
review_text: Best dishes recommendation since we always go back for them - Grilled cheese - Kimchi Pork Belly Sauteed with Tofu - Seafood Pancake - and the grilled meats…. AMAZINGG!!!! - Free ice cream 💯 Great service and good for friends gathering since one portion is quite a lot.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Dung Tran
review_text: Tasty food. Big portions. Good vibes. The owner is so sweet! Had a great lunch here. Would definitely come again!

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Ms Gift
review_text: The food I got was delicious. As someone who never takes back food to my hotel room when traveling, this is my first taking my remaining food back to my room because I couldn’t finish it. The server and the manager were very attentive and helpful. Would definitely come back💯

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Tôm
review_text: This is a great place if u wanna try original-flavored korrean dishes! I suggest that u should have 1 bowl per 2 pp if u can't eat much^^ (I rlly love the banchan here, they refill almost instantly)

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Felicia Samin
review_text: The food here taste similar to actual Korean food. We especially love the pajeon.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Vân Lê
review_text: we came with 2 for lunch and ordered jajangmeon, steamed egg, kimchi soup and grilled belly pork, total bill was ab 600, quite good price for a Korean cuisine restaurant in D1 district quite big portion of the jajang, and it's on promotion 99k any noodle (it's 150k on menu) good and well served food even the panchan; free ice-cream after meal clean and nice restaurant, helpful staff and an active owner, I guessed, was there to help, offer the ice cream, asking for feedback,...

author: Emilio
review_text: I’m not really a soup person, so this review comes from that perspective. The broth had a good flavor, and adding the fresh herbs and vegetables made it even better. The beef was good and the toppings were fresh. The phở was enjoyable even for me, and the service was efficient and quick. A very good experience overall.

author: Steve Hawkins
review_text: Being visiting this place over the years, I think it has the best pho by far. The staff are always running around serving the multitudes and are friendly. The serving size and other fresh side ingredients are always on point. The atmosphere is ok, but you don't go there for atmosphere, it's the really nice pho. The seating area is always busy and sometimes you struggle to get a seat. But it won't take long and it's well worth a little wait. It placed on a corner so you can watch the world go by. Definitely a must visit

author: Will Iam
review_text: Great place for authentic Vietnamese phở at any time of the day or night. Prices are super low and very affordable, especially considering the quality. The Phở Bò Kho is very tasty, rich in flavor, and well prepared. Being open 24/7 is a huge advantage, whether for an early breakfast or a late-night meal. Highly recommended if you are in the area.

author: Adam Fente
review_text: I ate here almost everyday for a month during my time in HCM. The environment is busy and so are the staff but the quality of the noodle soups are excellent. I miss the Bo Kho which is the stewed beef dish in the photo, but the Pho Nam was my 2nd favorite dish here. I miss this place and hope I can eat there again in the future in HCM ❤️

author: Victor
review_text: Had an amazing combination bowl for 89k. Super easy to order with a menu including English. Simple menu with food that comes super fast. Absolutely delicious with good portions. Amazing breakfast option.

author: Michael M
review_text: We landed late and wanted to eat pho. Randomly stopped by and eat something warm. It’s now my favorite place to eat pho past 13:00. Delicious. Right amount of seasonings. Meatballs and raw beefs were soft every bite. Clear water. Fresh green veggies as a bit excessive. But I love and will come back.

author: Kong Wen Sheng
review_text: A very popular Pho shop that is located at the core of the street entering Bui Vien. From serving the community in the morning to serving tourists and part-goers at night, it’s positioned to fit all sorts of of customers. The flow comes in and out very quickly, but their beef is overcooked. Soup is decent but the beef didn’t pass on my standards, as it’s too stiff, either cut too thickly or overcooked, either way a no pass. To those who loves hard beef then this is recommended. To add on, coconut was old and has no flesh. Not much coconut juice too, meaning it’s not a fresh one.

author: Kisa Co
review_text: The Pho fulfilled my expectation, really delicious. Got a lot of veggie. The staffs were nice and so fast in serving. The price was great. For all of this was around 100Dong.

author: vu nguyen
review_text: 24 hour pho shop just on the outskirts of the walking street. Place was pretty packed at the time I went at 1030pm. Didn’t see anything exceptional about this place besides the convenience.

author: Casiopea
review_text: Loved the pho. Stew is darker as you are in south Vietnam. Pho delicious. Meat tender.

author: Philippa Pham Hughes
review_text: Not the best I ever ever had but good enough pho. A little too salty. A little expensive, too. But that’s to be expected given the location. Quaint space. Quick service. Had a fresh coconut to drink and that was delicious.

author: Alexander Brown
review_text: Would recommend the brisket pho over the beef. Very tasty - make sure to add the thai basil, hoisin sauce and chilli paste

author: Nisal
review_text: Really good Pho. Tried the beef brisket and meatball pho here and really liked it. Beef stew was a bit hard though. it's opened 24 hours as well.

author: Conrad
review_text: This place was really good 👍 100k for beef stew, greens, baguette and a beer. Sat on the intersection is a buzz of activity and scooters. The stew had tons of thick cut beef, soft and very tasty. What more can you ask for.

author: Sheen Utlang
review_text: Meaty pho, very fast service and approachable staff. Accessible and well ventilated.

author: Kim-Jimmy VELOUSAMY
review_text: One of the best Pho we’ve had in Ho Chi Minh! You should try. Each place has his own Pho and this one was our second best.

author: Ondřej Kaloud
review_text: Fresh herbs, good pho, I just expected different type of noodles

author: Ebbe Klinth
review_text: The best soup I've had in Southeast Asia so far! Absolutely delicious.

author: J G
review_text: I enjoyed the Pho here, we had been drinking on Bui Vien Street and really appreciated a good meal, reasonably priced and tasty

author: Jeremy Britanico
review_text: Good pho! Very tasty but not the cheapest, it is affordable tho. Clean, good service, the environment is not the most quiet, in fact, too many locals bugging you for your money. Service is good too!

author: lim jenn ching
review_text: I order beef combination pho, it doesnt comes with medium size, the rest of the choice does. Pho was decent it was tasteful meat is tender, beef ball bouncy tendon was succulent beef tripe was crunchy. It was happiness in one big bowl. During my visit it was packed so be prepare to wsit for them to attend to you. Overall i think for a good bowl of pho it was worth the wait. Oh yah there will be line too if its nearer to lunch time.

author: Anika Patil
review_text: Dropped by Pho Hoa Pasteur on Pasteur Street and had their beef pho. The broth was rich and fragrant, with a nice balance of flavors — deep but clean. The beef cuts and noodles felt fresh and generous. Good value for the price definitely worth checking out if you want a solid bowl of pho in Saigon.

author: Lawrence Lau
review_text: My second visit! The pho was amazing! Broth was flavourful, beef was tender. The highlight to me is the wholly new experience! Order the dishes of your choice from the menu on the wall (I had combination pho for 105k dong), then choose the fragrant leaves of your choice (I had lots of basil)... Just take with your hands, tear out the leaves and pop in your pho (don't worry about price). Suqeeze the lime if you like (I squeezed a few drops into my spoonful of noodles and soup right before I put it in my mouth 😄). Add the raw bean sprouts if you like. Take the fried dough fritters (they will somehow calculate when you ask for the bill), take a bite and dunk the open end in the soup, enjoy the next soup-soaked bite, repeat 😆. Also try the brown sauce in the squeeze bottle.

author: Matthew Perry
review_text: This is the first meal we ate after landing to Vietnam! Everything from Pho to the Ca Phe Sua Da are amazing! The Pho has a very light and delicate flavorful broth, with a brisket that is so tender. Banh Bao also brings a tender juicy flavorful filling, the sweet and savory meat really makes the Banh Bao stand out among the other steamed bun I ate before. The Spring Rolls are also amazing and better if dipped on a sauce. And their Iced Coffee is just what I expected, strong and sweet! The ambiance is okay, but it is spacious and the staff are kind! The menu that are plastered on the wall was so helpful so that we dont need to ask for the menu everytime!

author: DoublePun
review_text: A local friend recommended this place, so I gave it a try, and regretted it. I ordered the combination beef pho, fried spring rolls, fresh rolls, and lean pork paste. The pho itself was mediocre despite the generous portion. The beef was very tough and hard to chew, and the broth was bland and oily. Even my friend admitted it used to be much better. The fried spring rolls were great, but the fresh rolls were terrible—basically just rice paper filled with vegetables, lacking flavor. The biggest issue, however, was hygiene. The side vegetables were served on one large shared plate that stayed on the table for different customers before and after us.I literally saw someone grab veggies with their bare hands, then put them back. No replacement. Absolutely disgusting. Overall, the food was underwhelming, and the low hygiene standards completely ruined the experience for me.

author: Ottotinne
review_text: Delicious! We went here with a group of 10 for some Phở breakfast, we were not disappointed. A good menu and very palatable food & Vietnamese coffee. Seats can fill up pretty quickly, so please be mindful of the time.

author: Christine KIM
review_text: [Ambiance] The restaurant is a bit away from the main tourist area, but still quite popular with visitors. Compared to the famous pho spots right in the city center, this place feels much more local and authentic. The space is large and clean. The first floor doesn’t have air conditioning, so it can get a bit warm, while the second floor has AC but it’s quite weak. [Service] The staff don’t speak much English, but they understand orders well and the food came out quickly and accurately. They’re not overly friendly like in some touristy restaurants, but they seem hardworking and sincere — focused on getting things done properly. [Food] ▪︎Fresh Cold Roll – Fresh and clean flavors, with a perfect balance of herbs. ▪︎Spring Roll – The coating was a bit thick for my taste. ▪︎Well Done Brisket – The beef slices were thick and generous, but a bit tough, which made it hard for kids to eat. I wonder if the Raw Beef option would have been more tender.

author: SD
review_text: Pho for breakfast was something I didn’t know I needed. I had the beef brisket pho and the broth was light but had an unbelievable depth of flavour. There were plenty of limes, herbs and sauces available on the table so you could season it to taste. Don’t let the portion deceive you, it’s surprisingly filling with the meat slices and the noodles. I did find the meat slices a little tasteless on their own but not enough to put a damper on the meal.

author: Christian Breitkreutz
review_text: Classic pho place in the heart of the city. This place is quite big: two seating levels. It’s popular by locals as well as tourists. Prices are slightly higher than in other places. But it‘s worth it. I had pho bo tai. The broth was very fragrant and the meat super tender. I also ordered a lot of the Chinese dough. Forgot the name. But I love it!

author: Adriana purwani Sukmawati Azhari
review_text: Went here in my 2nd day. I am satisfied with everything. The food 👍👍👍 Ambience 👍👍👍 Make sure if u travel alone just take the small portion. Cz i didn’t finish my whole bowl, that was really big portion huhu. But the is nice 🫶🏼😻

author: Linh Nguyen
review_text: Absolutely incredible pho — easily the best I’ve had anywhere. The broth is rich, aromatic, and perfectly balanced — not overly sweet like many places in Australia tend to make it. You can really taste the depth of flavour and the care that’s gone into preparing it. Everything from the fresh herbs to the tender noodles and meat was spot-on. If you’re a pho lover, this place is a must-try. I’ll definitely be coming back!

author: Ray Sim
review_text: My food rating guide: 2.5/5 ‐-------> Average taste 5/5 ‐--------> Scrumptious! (My comfort food! 🤩) Nice bowl of pho. Tender fresh beef and al dente beef ball. Medium bodied savoury soup. Smooth and soft noodle. Clean taste. The pho was a 4.5/5

author: Li0neL Ng
review_text: Authentic Vietnamese pho, much much much better than other vietnamese pho in my country... The chilli isn't that spicy. The broth is refreshing & rich of taste The place surprisingly clean & it's pretty cold in the upstairs coz they have AC & fans The staff is very friendly even when they have a lot of foreigners visitors The owner is very kind, he helped me exchanged money from big amount to small amounts So far this is the BEST pho & Vietnam food I've ate. i ate on 3-4 pho restaurant in totals on this 12 days Vietnam trips

author: Mariah Shane Ng
review_text: It was my first time trying an authentic pho and it was so good! The broth is very tasty and there are a lot of greens that you can add. Just be careful on adding lime can it can really alter the taste. We tried the fresh spring roll. It was so-so. If you are not fond of vegetable, skip it cause the greens are overpowering. The fresh juices are very tasty and refreshing. Lastly, the dough sticks are not free but they'll put it in your table even if you didn't order it. But if you'll not eat it, it will not be charged to you. Will definitely go back before flying back home.

author: tabitha
review_text: i could say this place is tourist friendly since most of the staffs speak little english and they do accept payment by card. food was great, the service was quite good, i just wish they’d explained briefly about how you eat the condiments that were prepared on the table cause i had no clue as it was my first time eating pho

author: Steve Hawkins
review_text: Great little place that we got recommended by the concierge at the hotel and it didn't disappoint either. Really tasty large portions with a heap of side vegetables to add to your soup. It was 90,000vnd fir the normal size and 105,000vnd for the large. The normal was enough fir us as this was largecto me. If you're nearby drop in for a visit for some of the best Pho I've tasted.

author: Thitika K
review_text: I ordered the beef pho, the soup was really good. The beef was tender. On the table there so many sauces, you can add fresh chili and there are many fresh vegetable provided.

author: Ced Aquino
review_text: The pho (d 105k) with a combination of different cuts of beef was delicious. The broth was flavorful pairing well with the fresh greens on the table. The serving was generous and very filling. The apple juice (d 35k) was refreshing though the portion was a bit small. The place is popular with both locals and tourists but the wait time isn't too long.

author: Alex
review_text: Had this recommended by ChatGPT all the bottom tables were taken, but they have an upstairs section and a section off of that upstairs section which had some seats I got the pho tai chin. That was delicious. Rich broth and lots of sides to add. I also got the iced tea. That was excellent. Service was very fast when you’re done they give you a receipt so you can take to pay at the front counter. Pro tip: bring your own napkins. They charge you 2000 If you use that wet wipe and there’s no napkins on the table.

author: Ragavendra Baburao
review_text: • One of the most legendary pho spots in Saigon — clean, consistent, and full-bodied broth. • Tried the brisket bowl and it was the best I’ve ever had • Locals and expats alike swear by it. → Go here if you want a no-fail, OG pho experience.

author: Tran Vinh Phuc
review_text: Nhà Hàng Ngon Great place to experience a wide variety of traditional Vietnamese dishes in one location. The menu is extensive, covering specialties from different regions, and everything we tried was well-prepared and flavorful. The grilled fish was perfectly cooked with a nice balance of spices, the fried rice was fragrant and not greasy, and the clam soup was light, aromatic, and comforting. Desserts were also a highlight—classic Vietnamese sweets done right, not overly sweet. The atmosphere is lively and authentic, making it ideal for both tourists and locals who want to explore Vietnamese cuisine. Service was efficient despite the restaurant being quite busy. Prices are reasonable for the quality and variety offered. Highly recommended if you want a reliable introduction to Vietnamese food in a comfortable setting.

author: Pattararatda
review_text: A popular - touristy - restaurant right in the heart of District 1, with a menu that spans local, fusion, and broader Asian cuisine. The food isn't up to my personal liking but it does a great job of catering to diverse groups. I, however, love their innovative and excellent drink menus (btw the vietnamese coffee is crazily strong!). Service is impeccable. Be prepared for a crowd, this place is huge but super popular.

author: vu nguyen
review_text: Huge elegant restaurant that feels like a chateau with a massive outdoor seating arraignment. Large menu selection that has a little bit of everything from a vietnamese cuisine perspective. My mom and aunt ordered the hot pot with fish and baked fish, while I ordered the pork in the clay pot. Would definitely go again.

author: Abraham Lee
review_text: Ngon offers a semi-outdoor dining experience that was cool and relaxing in the evening, though it might feel a bit warm on a hotter day. The setting is immaculate .. beautifully decorated and almost like stepping into someone’s grand home. The food was decent, and while the staff had limited English proficiency, they were attentive and helpful. Overall, it was a pleasant and impressive place to dine.

author: Randall Huskinson
review_text: Really special environment. Excellent food quality. I asked out tour company to arrange upscale lunch someplace our group could try a variety of Vietnamese dishes beyond pho. This place knocked of out of the park. The food was fresh and delicious and a real balance of dishes including meat, fish, and veggies. The space itself is wildly creative and welcoming. Would definitely return!

author: CHENIS SS
review_text: The restaurant has a lovely atmosphere with beautiful decor. Most of the area is semi-outdoor, which can get a bit warm depending on the season, but it still feels cozy and relaxing. The place is quite spacious and can host many guests. There’s also a second floor that’s quieter and more peaceful — perfect if you want a calm dining experience. The staff are kind and helpful, though their English communication is a bit limited. The food tastes good overall 🍽️, but a few dishes seemed not freshly prepared (a little cold and not very warm). Still, everything was flavorful and enjoyable.

author: CJ Lawrence - CliveyBwoy
review_text: Ngon is very cool, in the heart of the city it’s a pretty busy place so maybe a reservation might be best. We arrived just looking for a table for 3 and waited a short while (no more than 5 minutes) before being guided to our table. It’s a big restaurant, stunning decor, family friendly with a very relaxed atmosphere. The menu is extensive, there is plenty to choose from, it’s not all traditional dishes, there a western mix too. I can’t remember the dish I ordered but it was a seafood salad, being it was still early lunch time. The prices seemed fair, I guess, it took a little while to arrive (but it was busy) but I have to say I had more salad than seafood and was slightly disgruntled that the balance wasn’t quite there. That’s when I started to question the price. Did I just pay 100k for a lot of cucumber? 🤣 Anyway, delicious as it was I was totally blown away by the decor. The walls are a deep, sensual red, making it ideal for a hot date, the lighting and garden, pond area are just visually breathtaking and really set the tone. I saw many families, a few couples and just groups of friends hanging out so this restaurant really caters for everyone. The staff were attentive and polite and brought out the baby seat for the little one, so we were made to feel comfortable and were never made to feel ignored or forced to holler for anything we needed. A good experience overall, and a happy tummy if not a very appreciative wallet. But you can’t have it all eh!

author: Keerati Lakakum
review_text: The food here is flavorful and well-prepared, with a wide variety of dishes to choose from. Prices are reasonable and in line with the standard. The staff provide great service, making the overall dining experience very enjoyable. This is definitely a must-visit spot for anyone coming to Ho Chi Minh City.

author: EC Chan
review_text: Authentic Vietnamese food at very reasonable price for such cosy and nice ambience. They served Thai and Chinese cuisine too but I was focusing just their Vietnamese dishes and never disappoint with it. Service was not too bad but can be improved because there were quite busy during lunch time. Food quality is top notch and the price is reasonable. Will definitely come back again

author: Tee Wang
review_text: Every time I come back to visit Vietnam, this would be the first restaurant that I stop by before venturing out to try all the street foods. Of course the prices in here are a bit more than other restaurants but you’re paying for the view, the services, and the beautiful interior. It’s quite cozy. After a long flight, I just want to relax first before experiencing eating in the hot weather of Vietnam. 😆 It’s an overall a great experience. I love their variety of drinks.

author: Andrew Goh
review_text: This restaurant offers traditional Vietnamese cuisine and features charming decor inspired by traditional Vietnamese architecture. The seating is small and closely packed, and there is no air conditioning—only fans—so visiting during summer in Ho Chi Minh City might be challenging. The fried spring rolls, supposedly a signature Vietnamese dish, were disappointing due to their lack of crispiness; the skin didn’t crack as expected and stuck unpleasantly when eaten. The fresh spring rolls were also underwhelming, with tough wraps that were difficult to bite through, likely due to being pre-prepared and dried out. The steamed sea snails were bland, and the mango salad was just average. The grilled chicken lacked proper marination, though the boiled chicken stood out with its flavorful and tasty meat. The so-called “king” dish, tapioca with luncheon meat, was bland and not something I would recommend. The spicy fried squid was a letdown, as the overcooked squid became chewy. On a positive note, the baked crab was an impressive dish, although the crab meat could have been more flavorful. Overall, the dining experience was mixed, with a few highlights but many areas for improvement.

author: Cee ee
review_text: We ordered appetizers as soon as we arrived, and they were served quickly. However, the experience went downhill with the main course. Only my companion’s dish was served, and I had to wait almost an hour for mine. When we followed up, we were repeatedly told it would be “5 more minutes,” but the wait kept getting longer. When my food finally arrived, it was no longer hot. The server also seemed upset when I said I no longer wanted to eat it, even though we still paid the bill. Overall, this was a disappointing experience. Not recommended. Consider hiring staff who can speak and understand English clearly. Good communication is essential for providing proper service, and it should not be this difficult.

author: Genesis Macale
review_text: Best bun cha I've eaten in Vietnam, having visited this country thrice. I wanted to come back just to eat this again there! The service was very fast too. The place generally felt like a palace. So large and so many people.

author: Aaron Tay
review_text: Food was very tasty and authentic. The ambience is very nice and the staff are very attentive. Great place to bring colleagues and international visitors. While this is a little pricey compared to other local establishments, it is still reasonable for the portions (Asian size please).

author: Vei Vei
review_text: This restaurant is very popular with both tourists and locals. It offers a spacious setting with both indoor and outdoor seating, kept cool mainly by fans. The staff is numerous and fairly quick, though not particularly friendly. The menu is diverse, and while the prices are high, they are reasonable given the restaurant’s location and reputation. However, if you're looking for typical local dishes at budget-friendly prices, you might want to think twice before dining here.

author: Aaron Pham
review_text: Ngon Restaurant in Ho Chi Minh City has an impressively large menu with plenty of options to choose from. The food quality is great overall, and I especially enjoyed the hacao dumplings—they’re generously sized and flavorful. The snail dishes are also worth trying if you’re looking for something unique. That said, I felt the prices were a bit on the higher side compared to the portions and overall value, but the taste and presentation did make up for it. The staff are quick and attentive, which makes the dining experience smooth, and it’s very convenient that they accept card payments here. Overall, I walked away pretty happy with the experience—a good mix of variety, quality, and efficient service, even if the prices felt slightly elevated.

author: Bożena Wróblewska
review_text: Wonderful Asian cuisine, including excellent Vietnamese dishes, served in beautifully designed interiors. The décor is rich in flowers and greenery – artificial, yet tastefully arranged. Elegant, cozy, and full of details that create an atmosphere of luxury and comfort. A perfect spot for a special dinner

author: Rosie C
review_text: Decent place for big groups and all rounded Vietnamese cuisine. Music was too loud for my liking, could barely hear my lunch guests over it. And was difficult to get hold of a waitress as they seemed understaffed. Food was tasty though!

author: Charles Bronson (CNorris)
review_text: It was all very good but pricey compared to similar nearby. However the place is an open air with misters sort of place so not too hot but still humid. Ate with a 8+ crod and was good. But didn't stand out above. Maybe I should have tried the octopus.

author: Art
review_text: I loved the food but dishes came out at different times and the service had some small issues. Not much AC, kinda hit. Edit: I went back a second time simply because it was convenient and was sorely disappointed, which had caused me to lower my review to a 3 star. When we arrived we didn’t seem to have an assigned waitress, no one came to take our order or greet us for a while until I was more aggressively looking at waitstaff near me so someone would come. Two waitresses seemed confused in who was supposed to take our orders until one finally came over. The waitress was courteous, but we never saw her again. No one came to check on our meals at all. When the meal finally came it was not as good as the meal I first ordered the other day. I was a little disappointed because the image was different than the reality. I was expecting peas, baby corns, and broccoli with my dish from the image but instead got heaps of mushrooms, celery, and onions with some broccoli and other veggies. Though strangely only two tiny pieces of red pepper? It didn’t explicitly say which vegetables we would get, but I was less enthused. Overall I didn’t feel like I received good service, perhaps because I’m a foreigner, and since I’ve gone two times and received bad service both times, I feel like these are not isolated incidents. Also, the food came out at different times again. Though the restaurant is absolutely gorgeous and the staff were pleasant, and the food wasn’t terrible.

author: María MF
review_text: Very nice staff and delicious food. Very fresh fish and seafood and cheaper than others. The problem is that they take so much time to bring the food. Almost an hour for one piece of fish…

author: Chong Delon
review_text: Anything you order, will be worth your penny. Seafoods and fishes are fresh. Portion is huge. Very very local place and vibes. You know it's a great place when there is not much tourist hanging around. A gem place to visit.

author: Igo Grego
review_text: Recommended by the lady in the pharmacy. Then i walked in to the restaurant. Seafood was really good, especially the shrimp 🦐 Many Locals are dine here

author: Dewi D
review_text: This restaurant serves very fresh seafood and the owner was so helpful with suggestion. Our seafood dishes were steamed with ginger n garlic sauce to bring out the sweetness of fresh seafood. Price point is also reasonable. This restaurant is a come back.

author: Rocky Mok
review_text: Amazing good value local spot, and very tasty! The seafood has lots of variety….! And service is great. Good comes out fast, even when it’s packed!!

author: Ori Joy
review_text: Wide variety of fresh live seafood, You can choose from 3 methods of cooking - steamed, fried or grilled. Our family love all the dishes as the seafood is fresh and cooked well. There are 2 seating areas- indoors and outdoors. Due to a passing shower, the indoor area was quite packed. We can tell that this restaurant is popular among the locals. There’s a menu for foreigners but I’m not sure how fluent in English are the waiters; we told our guide what we wanted and he helped us speak to the waiter. Overall, a satisfactory dinner

author: Thanh Ly
review_text: Da Nang has hundreds of seafood restaurants and it's easy to get overwhelmed by the sheer number of restaurants offering fresh/live seafood. We were very fortunate that this restaurant was 7 minutes from our Airbnb. We found it while we were pushing our little boy around so he could fall asleep for his afternoon nap. This restaurant also happened to be on my list of researched places to eat, so we decided to try it out once the boy had fallen asleep. The restaurant wasn't particularly busy but we were between meals 4pm. It's a big restaurant and there were 5 tables, all locals. When the food arrived, we knew right away the quality was fantastic and the seafood fresh. The service was beyond fantastic, my wife wanted a fresh coconut, something they didn't offer but the staff went down the street and bought one, charged us the cost of the coconut only and not extra for the service (we paid 25k VND for it). We got a mixture of clams, one booked with lemongrass and chilli and the other in a coconut sauce, both absolutely delicious. We also got the Thai squid and papaya salad, which was as good as you'd get in Thailand. The restaurant was so good we have been there now 3 times in 4 days. One for lunch and twice for dinner, bringing my Vietnamese parents along with us. They really rate the good and I think we've tried pretty much all of their fresh seafood so far, we haven't had a disappointing dish yet. Our boy loves the chicken, which unfortunately does take about an hour as they cook it fresh and the minimum order is half a chicken. Works well for take away as he eats it late in the evening or in the morning. This is very much a local joint, the locals love it and for good reason. They dishes are fantastic and cooked right. Beer will cost you 17k VND for a bottle of Saigon beer. It's about 70% cheaper than Lang Ca (the famous seafood restaurant in Da Nang, avoid it like the plague), and much cheaper than any of the beach side seafood restaurants. We were there on Tuesday night and the place was rammed. Tour buses turn up and go to the place opposite, this restaurant doesn't need to rely on that business as they get so busy with the locals. They do have an English menu, so ordering shouldn't be a problem. The staff are fantastic and they go above and beyond to make customers feel at home. It's a big and clean restaurant. And despite what other reviews have said, it's not a Thai restaurant, I think they get a bit confused with the name. I'd highly recommend this place for some great seafood, at a very, very reasonable price, where you are experiencing the local vibe. You won't be disappointed.

author: Ching San Lim
review_text: So this was our first meal after touching down in Da Nang. Our guide brought us here as we said we only wanted to go where locals go and this was it. Every dish that we ordered was excellent and the best part of the service included pealing our mantis and sea prawns at the side for us so that all we needed to do was to open our mouth and chew. Definitely highly recommend this place 👍👍👍

author: Yvonne Ng
review_text: Fresh seafood. We tried steam prawns, steam fish, clams and fried rice. Excellent taste. Recommended by our local tour guide. Price is reasonable. Highly recommended.

author: 햄벅
review_text: It is not right next to the sea, but near the sea. It was a very delicious and satisfying meal. If I have a chance, I really want to go again. 한국인들 집합해야되는 곳 맛집

author: Markéta Jenčková
review_text: Overall a good experience. We had stir fry noodles with beef and it was delicious, the meat was cooked very nicely so we enjoyed that.

author: Lokesha Haber
review_text: You get to choose your fish or seafood directly, along with your preferred preparation method—grilled, steamed, sashimi, etc. Prices per kilogram are clearly displayed on each of the many fish tanks, and they confirm the total cost with you before cooking. The preparation was excellent, and the price was extremely reasonable. Yet another spot recommended by locals, and it definitely lived up to the reputation!

author: Trân P
review_text: Food is little below average. The seafood noodles is completely a lie and disappointment, only four small shrimps in there and they call it seafood?? The hotpot was low quality too. The oysters rather old and not fresh.Would not recommend it

author: Daniel Oppa
review_text: 250314 It's a low-cost food, but you need to be patient if you want to eat it after ordering.

author: Nino Kiers
review_text: The food was delicious! But the staff seemed really stressed out, as it was very busy. They forgot about some of our dishes which they then ran out of, and they added an extra dish to the receipt that we did not get. But they were really nice about it and refunded us immediately.

author: Z D Y
review_text: Went as a tour. Atmosphere is good and inviting. Food was ok. Good presentation. Service was ok. They cant speak english, abit of communication breakdown. Seafood is fresh.

author: Sathesh
review_text: Food was very nice especially if the cooking method is BBQ. The staff are friendly and very helpful especially when peeling the lobsters and the prawns. Price is there to see..

author: Douglas Whitcombe
review_text: Grilled Tiger Prawns and Oysters washed down with a Tiger hit the spot. Off the main waterfront strip so prices were reasonable

author: BDR Albadar
review_text: If you’re in da nang and you want try best seafood in local restaurants with good prices try this place so delicious food

author: M C
review_text: Da Nang local restaurant near Mike Beach. It is near the back of Hilton Hotel. I think it was the freshest and cheapest seafood restaurant near the beach. I visited on Saturday and there were a lot of people There were many kind steps, so it wasn't uncomfortable.

author: Shariah Isabelle Gomez
review_text: I JUST LOVE THIS PLACE!! Was shopping at Han Market and I was looking for somewhere nearby to sit and relax after shopping. And this was THE BEST place to do so! Very friendly staff, and the cashier and front staff understand english well! They helped me with local coffee roasters, as well as giving me great recommendations for other places to go to! Ha Vy, Phuong Doan, Thien Ngan, and Yon were the ones I spoke to, and they all were very welcoming! Excited to go back there and hoping to meet them again. Other than that, the view and vibes are excellent! I had many photos taken all thanks to the wonderful staff 🧡 (I almost forgot to add), coffee and pastries were delicious as well as affordable! I highly recommend their Salt Latte (the best one Ive had in Da Nang so far!)

author: Melanie E
review_text: Food: 5/5 I ordered the salted matcha milk and it was excellent. They offer a good selection of teas, coffees, and smoothie drinks. Service: 5/5 great service Atmosphere: 5/5 a great vibe to chill with your friends.

author: preba moodley
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Ut Tich Cafe in Da Nang is a hidden gem! Their salt coffee is hands down the best in town, perfectly balanced with a unique flavor you won’t forget. The coconut coffee is undoubtedly the best in Da Nang — rich, creamy, and absolutely delicious. If you’re in the mood for something refreshing, their peach iced tea is a must-try — light, fruity, and so satisfying. A cozy spot with incredible drinks — highly recommended for coffee lovers visiting Da Nang! 🌟

author: karan shorey
review_text: The outside seating gives this busy place a welcoming vibe. Located right opposite the river, it makes for a good view of the hectic street traffic and the calm river just beyond. I found the coconut coffee average, comapred to what I experienced in other shops in Danang/Hoi An or across other cities. Sweetened coconut flakes that come with the coffee are nice to nibble on.

author: Rhys Travel
review_text: Great coffees. Beautiful views to the Han river. The service was a bit slow for upstairs as there was only one server.

author: Rachel Jordan
review_text: This cafe is very spacious- and nice and cool on a hot day! The drink glasses are huge. We had the Strawberry Smoothie and Bác Xiu- both delicious!

author: Marcus Yong Chee Kuan Yong
review_text: This seaside spot is absolutely stunning—breathtaking views and a peaceful atmosphere. Highly recommend stopping by to relax and unwind!

author: Tani Wade
review_text: Fabulous coffee and pastry shop! We love the coconut smoothie and coconut coffee! Friendly staff, many many of them. There is outdoor and AC seating. Overlooking the river. Reasonable prices and fast delivery of food. Can takeaway or enjoy at the restaurant.

author: Christine Doan
review_text: Wonderful coffee house with beautiful river & city views. My cousin brought me here & i was very impressed by the ambiance. The decor gives a nostalgic vibe (ex. vintage sewing machine & media (cassette/radio players). I recommend the coconut coffee. ☕️ Will definitely return.

author: Rob
review_text: What's not to love about this place. Awesome smoothies, great friendly service with a smile, great atmosphere as you sit and watch De Nang go slowly by.

author: Kimberly T
review_text: Fun and yummy drinks, cool space to escape the heat, or sit outside and enjoy the riverview. We got a brown sugar boba and a tamarind drink with peanuts.

author: Eden Dayuha
review_text: I came to relax and chill but it's impossible because the music is too loud and vehicles passing by are too noisy as well. Their drinks are the best, though. Highly recommend this cafe for just a short stay, I can't stay longer in a noisy place like that.

author: Dita Ling
review_text: Arrived here way too much early at 7am,but the staff team is so welcoming. The whole cafe has very good atmosphere and relaxing vibe, enjoys the Vietnamese pop music, chilling. Recommend the coconut coffee with coconut flakes. Super addictive.

author: JustLinahere
review_text: We went there to kill some time before leaving for the airport. We sat outside and ordered mango smoothie and peach tea. Both drinks were refreshing. But we couldn't enjoy it, we had to endure some tobacco smokes since we were in the open area.

author: Cielo Tierra
review_text: We were looking for shelter from the rain and decided to step into this café. What a pleasant surprise! We loved the decor, the different seating areas, the location, and most of all, the quality of the coffee. Another great highlight was the excellent and fast service.

author: Jan Goergen-Makinson
review_text: We popped in for our usual coconut coffee and salted coffee. They were delicious. The coconut flakes were so crunchy and just perfect.

author: Paris Andrews
review_text: Absolutely delicious coffee and a lovely refreshing smoothie. Usually when travelling we like to try different places but definitely coming back. I did a little dance of happiness when leaving 🕺

author: Corey
review_text: 📝 Summary: you pay the price for the trending location by the river, but you get a nice atmosphere to eat and drink a good coffee served by friendly Staff. 🏠 The setting is very nice, beautiful decoration style and the staff is LOVELY! They're smiling, helpful, speaks English, helped me understand Vietnamese money(my first day) and even cross the busy street traffic! 👩‍🍳 You can seat on small individual tables or group up on comfy sofas, upstairs has clean bathroom and balcony for more intimacy. As always I find the music too loud(style is typical electro-pop) like everywhere in south Asia it's not specific to this café. 🥯 They have a few bakery/pastry (35-40K) but I found the almond croissant a bit weird, maybe because of the cream stuffing inside. The Cinnamon roll was good. Finally the coffee, tried a hot ☕ Cappuccino (50K...ouch!) but it was good, not burning hot, correct foam/milk ratio, beautiful art.. served with an Oreo because why not. 💲I've had cheaper coffee.. but I've also had worst coffee so you get what you pay for!

author: Care LUSA
review_text: Coconut shake here is the best! Salted coffee try it but don't forget to stir before drink🤣. If you like to selfie I suggest this place. If you have to across the road the staffs there will help you ❤️

author: Pichitra Tovivich
review_text: Good coffee, good atmosphere, good service, and better taste than famous one.
